Object.Description: As the plentiful bounty of a flourishing Spring is bestowed upon the Realm, see what her gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in Spring Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of May 2022.
A rare and exquisite flower, found in the wildest reaches of a Realm in the height of Spring.\n\nItems contained in Spring Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of May 2022.

Flames dance upon the molten surface of this crate. Open it to get one of the following:

*Fiery Katana
*Pyro Sheath
*Flame Guard
*Firelight Necklace
*Mini Fiery Kensei Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover
A light powerful blade, capable of burning even the toughest opponents.
This sheath can be a great tool in the hands of an experienced Kensei.

EffectInfo.name: On Wearing the Full Set
EffectInfo.description: Bullets deal 600 damage and travel longer distance

Object.Description: Made of refractory material, this heavy armor is capable of summoning a powerful creature for extra defense.

EffectInfo.name: On Hit
EffectInfo.description: Summons a fire lizard for 0.9 seconds

Object.Description: A beautiful accessory which burns constantly to guide you through battle.
...a driving force, indeed the driving force of nature and of civilization, would drive us once again to...
We sought to ape its astonishing force, to reproduce it in our environment...
...the principle of things that are, Water could take all forms that make up our world, and we harnessed it...
...our Mother and our Essence and our livelihood... we would now seek its full potential.
Within this relic all elements swirl in perfect equilibrium. What would otherwise unleash cataclysmic disaster holds together in immaculate arcane homeostasis. We would surpass it.

EffectInfo.name: Fury of Flame and Storm
EffectInfo.description: Gain +5 attack and dexterity while attacking if your health is above 90% Max HP

EffectInfo.name: Perseverance of Land and Water
EffectInfo.description: Gain +5 defense and +15 vitality for 10 seconds when taking damage below 60% Max HP

Object.Description: And the Great Wave bore upon our dwellings, flushing us and our beasts and our tools... but one remained, and he held aloft his blade, and summoned to himself the powers that still haunted this place.
Our elder would look upon the storms and pondered on how a thing with no substance could leave but desolation in its wake.
What force would do but the very force behind life and movement? No other. This weapon would prove it.
She had read the tomes of other races, and she had the wisdom of the Earth. She saw how we must proceed.
Its pages are slightly damp and little of the ink remains readable after apparent water damage. It was a treatise on Water by an eminent sage, but someone has been scribbling in the margins.

Activate.title: Book of Water

Object.Description: Not many pages remain of this tome. It was a treatise on Air by a famous philosopher, but someone has been using it to seemingly keep records.

Activate.title: Book of Air

Object.Description: Most of this book has burned away. It was a treatise on Fire by an ancient scholar, but some of the text differs.

Activate.title: Book of Fire
Activate.text:
{i}...no one of gods and men has made this world, but it always was and will be an ever-living fire...

...all that lives and walks upon this earth, animated by the very essence of destruction...

{color=#30647e}...a paradoxical fusion of Flame and...

...the power to alter our existence.{/color}{/i}

Object.Description: Most of its pages have been damaged or torn away. It was a treatise on Earth by a learned one, but it has been written on again at a later time.

Activate.title: Book of Earth

Object.Description: This experimental device harnesses the power of lightning, allowing you to science your enemies senseless with raw energy.
Slamming this charred iron rod into the ground will summon elemental energies to blast anyone who comes close.

EffectInfo.description: Zaps enemies for 250 damage every 0.2 seconds slowing for 2 seconds as long as the trap remains untriggered.
EffectInfo.name: Elemental Energies

Object.Description: You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.

EffectInfo.description: Releases 3 damaging sparks (200-275 damage) in a cone.
EffectInfo.name: On taking at least 20 damage

Object.Description: This gigantic wig contains a lot of electrical energy due to being 90% wire wool.
The edge has been made blunt and ragged from smashing into trees, doors, walls, and pesky hikers.
This once held potatoes. Now it can barely hold back his rage.
The cloth does nothing to soften incoming attacks, but the blows only make the wearer angrier.

EffectInfo.description: gain a 20 HP/s Healing buff for 1 second.
EffectInfo.name: On shoot while Bleeding

Object.Description: The teddy's head is down the well with the others.

Open it to find one of the following:

*Mythical ST Gem
*Mythical ST Shards
*Mystery ST Chest
*Mystery ST Shards
Can be used in the Forge to craft Resurrected Huntress Items.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Killbilly Warrior Items.
You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.

As the nameless monarch sat malcontent upon the throne, his ambitions and impiety became one, and with this came enlightenment. A legacy reduced to less than legend, utterly erased from the nescient minds of the land, with its only epitaph being the sorry remnant of his majesty's dearest. After all, what good are kings in a realm of gods?
The symbol that claims absolute subservience from its beholder.

EffectInfo.description: Item is not available to players.
EffectInfo.name: Exclusive Item

Object.Description: Can be used as an Artifact in the Enchanter or used directly to generate "Conqueror's Crown".

EffectInfo.description: Item is not available to players.
EffectInfo.name: Exclusive Item

EffectInfo.description: Cannot roll T1 to T3 enchantments.
EffectInfo.name: Exclusion

Object.Description: These intricately crafted blades were originally intended more for ornamental purposes rather than function, but still remain potent for any form of combat.
A set of knives wrapped in an ever burning flame.
Razor sharp gemstone blades that emit a faint, magic hum.
Blades wielded only by those among the strongest of mortals, their green edges gleam in sunlight.
Used primarily in ritual worship, repeated exposure to dark magic has imbued this pair of daggers with sinister powers.
Entire wars have been waged over the bloodstone of which a pair of these blades has been crafted from. A single pair carries the cost of thousands of deaths.
These blades are made from a material beyond the reaches of the realm, their origin shrouded in mystery, but their edge undoubtedly sharp.
The weight of a single swing carries the vigor of a hundred past heroes, their souls bound together in the shape of blades so they may once again slay evil.
A pair of weighty swords that carry with it thunderous strikes from its namesake.
Blades made from the bones of infernal beings, used to fell the same creatures it was forged from.
Tempered blades crafted from enchanted Darksteel and set with a gleaming ruby.
This dense set of blades has been crafted with the bones of beasts only spoken of through legend.
A pair of blades of unknown origin, within their edges a dark power can be felt, threatening to corrupt the user should they not be sated in battle.
Keen blades that never grow dull, their slashes threaten to split the very sky itself.
Weapons of striking beauty, their colors displaying all the shades of twilight, each slash like a brushstroke, painting its own landscape.
The culmination of countless generations of swordsmiths, each perfecting their craft and improving these blades gradually. The pinnacle of weapons created by mortals for use in slaying the immortal.
Commissioned by a particularly gaudy lord for his armies, this flail gleams as brightly as the armor he was once known to wear.
Often seen used in arenas across the lands, flails like these offer a perfect balance of weight and power.
Once wielded by a band of knights from atop their lightning drake companions, a thunderous roar can be heard with each swing.
Forged in the fires of the underworld, the mace atop this flail emits a heat reminiscent of its origins.
A masterpiece of craftsmanship with the strongest and most desirable of all metals, as deadly as it is egregiously expensive.
Granted only to heroes who have returned from missions of world saving renown. Those who receive it are cemented in legend.
Gifted from the heavens to the most righteous of mortals, these flails have been imbued with the power of angels to subjugate evil entities.
The primary armament of the gravelords of old, eternally tasked with making sure the dead are forever sealed away from the mortal plane.
An impossibly intricate pattern belies these blades, carved from a self-perfecting crystalline deity.
An extraordinarily dense silversteel anchor attached to a magical kelpwoven chain. Whatever ship it was attached to has long since been dragged to the depths.
Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.

Open it to find one of the following:

*Mythical ST Shards
*Mystery ST Chest
*Mystery ST Shards
*Golden Lucky Clover
*Lucky Clover
*Loot Drop Potion
The very lack of any identifying elements make this seemingly inconspicuous package arouse suspicion...
It's been told this cache has been frozen for ages...

Object.Description: A medallion with some of the energy stolen by the Syndicate. Return it to the Quest Room to obtain great prizes.

EffectInfo.description: Obtained by defeating the Syndicate in the Hidden Interregnum
EffectInfo.name: Drop location

Object.Description: A letter inside a magically-sealed envelope which magic has faded.

Activate.title: Shrouded Summons
Activate.text:
Greetings,
 
I have heard of your plight and believe we have similar goals; to bring about the downfall of Oryx.
To this end I have devised a plan, but I need trusted comrades to carry it out.
I offer no power nor riches, but I can promise you the Mad God's end.
Should you wish to join me, take the coin enclosed within this letter and speak unto it.
You will know what to do from there.
 
{i}-A Friend{/i}

Object.Description: A letter that one of the Syndicate members dropped.

Activate.title: Intercepted Letter 1
Activate.text:
My dearest companions,
 
You are among my most trusted and capable allies, and I have a task only you are capable of.
I would have you return to the realm and hunt the most powerful of the realm's denizens to siphon their strength.
We will need an incredibly high volume of power to perform the ritual that will mark the culmination of our efforts.
Should you find the heroes of the nexus as I have before, shift your target unto them.
It is a regrettable outcome as they fall on the same side as us.
However, we need all the power we can get and they are not ones so easy to work with, trust me, I've tried.
Remember, if you are to return you must bring the coins with you, they are your only way back.
 
{i}-W.{/i}

Object.Description: A letter that one of the Syndicate members dropped.

Activate.title: Intercepted Letter 2
Activate.text:
Members of the Syndicate,
 
Our goal is on the horizon. 
Soon I will rip the Mad God Himself from the realm and bring him here, to a place where his influence cannot reach.
This dimension shall be his tomb, no longer able to return to the realm, all the power he has will be meaningless.
However, this ritual is hardly accurate, unfortunately I have a high chance of taking a large chunk of the realm with him. 
The damage could be heavy, but sacrifices must be made.
In time the realm will heal, and you all will be there to help it grow once again.
 
{i}-W.{/i}

Object.Description: A page from a journal, hastily written.

Activate.title: Vagrant's Journal
Activate.text:
I can't follow through with this anymore.
I joined early on to support the cause, but things have gone awry since then.
The executives are all blinded by their own goals, their desire for revenge.
They have lost sight of the true goal of the organization, to free the realm, and yet they call it a "necessary sacrifice"? 
We are talking about ripping a hole in the world, destroying part of the very realm they are freeing.
There has to be another way.
I'm planning on sneaking out of here and finding someone, anyone, to help me stop this before it gets out of hand.

Object.Description: A journal page from a pirate's log.

Activate.title: Captain's Log
Activate.text:
Years, we've been stranded on this Island, years.
There is a whole world to plunder out there but here we are unable to leave this glorified rock.
That damnable sea beast roams the waters taking down any ships that try to tread too far from shore.
We've managed to take care of him before, but that bloody tyrant wont let him stay gone.
My men are at their wit's end, if this continues I expect many to leave for the Mad God's armies, or worse, a Mutiny.
I need to figure something out before then...

Object.Description: A wood tablet written with magical ink.

Activate.title: Izel's Prayer
Activate.text:
{i}I beseech the spirits, grant me strength.
To ascend beyond the limits of my flesh.
I beseech the spirits, grant me leadership.
To unite the tribes against our true foe.
I beseech the spirits, grant me courage.
To oppose the False God and his stolen powers.
I beseech the spirits, grant me purpose.
To restore order to our chaotic lands.{/i}

Object.Description: A fine piece of parchment, written with a steady hand and stylish calligraphy.

Activate.title: Nefret's Journal
Activate.text:
I used to rule the desert, outranked by none. I was destined to become the next god of our people, but now? 
My people and my lands are gone, taken over by the Mad God without struggle.
He made our own gods subservient to him, for many of our people there wasn't even a second thought about taking him as their new ruler.
For me, I was simply pushed aside, no longer worshiped, no longer needed, left with only a small group of loyal followers. 
Robbed of my birthright I lack purpose, I need to reclaim my place, but I fear I lack the capability to do so.

Object.Description: A scroll, written with broad brush strokes.

Activate.title: Ozuchi's Vow
Activate.text:
Our war is over, we've lost.
The strength, the pride, of the great Oni clans is in shambles.
We were holding fast against his forces but it all came down to a single battle.
20 to 1, the greatest of our clan, the strongest warriors this realm has ever seen, all lost to a single man. 
His strength was overwhelming, presenting the battle more as an inconvenience than a fight for survival.
Our slaughter was quick, and with it, the largest remaining threat to his forces was no more.
I've thrown away my pride as a samurai, fleeing, so that at least one of us may survive.
I vow I will not let this humiliation go unpunished.

Object.Description: A page snatched from a journal.

Activate.title: The Wanderer's Journal Page 1
Activate.text:
I am plagued by recurring nightmares.
They all reflect the same thing, my home, its peaceful atmosphere quickly morphing to one of utter chaos.
The warning bells ring out as an army marches on the horizon, thousands of soldiers armed to the teeth surge forth.
They rip apart our guards within mere moments, and from there they start butchering civilians without impunity. 
I hide in the sewers, watching from the grates as my entire world is set on fire.
Amid it all stands a figure clad in obsidian commanding his minions to destroy everything I have ever known.
It was then that I awoke to my power. Many would call it a gift, but to me it's a reminder.

Object.Description: A page snatched from a journal.

Activate.title: The Wanderer's Journal Page 2
Activate.text:
I have been in search of greater strength almost all my life, working towards the singular goal of enacting revenge against the Mad God.
Unfortunately I feel myself reaching the limit of my physical power. 
It seems to be time to explore other potential avenues, starting with my "gift".
This power allows me to rip open holes in our reality, creating passage from one place within the realm to another.
Thus far I have simply willed it to happen, and it did. 
I used it to travel the lands, seeking anyone willing to train me, but never have I tried to attain a deeper understanding into its limits.
Shortsighted as it may have been to miss it before, this is probably my only other option for dealing with a being that seemingly cannot die.

Object.Description: A page snatched from a journal.

Activate.title: The Wanderer's Journal Page 3
Activate.text:
Great strides have been made in experimentation with my powers.
I have found that I am capable of imbuing fragments of my power into objects, allowing a rift to be opened by any I grant one to.
That alone isn't very useful, but I have also found something...
Interesting...
A place akin to the nexus those heroes reside in, another dimension separate from the realm itself. It has eternally dark skies and no signs of any living creatures.
Within this place I can feel it, or rather a lack of it. Oryx's influence is nowhere to be found.
I think I am beginning to come up with a plan involving this place.
For this I am going to need a lot more strength, and despite my apprehension to leaving my fate in the hands of others, I'll need allies as well.

Object.Description: A simple, weather-beaten green cloak. It doesn't endow great powers - it conceals them until the time is right.
A hereditary armor constructed of intricate scales. The crest of the Oni Clans that adorns it can still be identified.
Stained by sea salt and equipped with bandoliers - the armor of a captain who fights at the forefront of her crew.
Handed down through generations of Pharaohs, it holds power over more than just the wills of Nefret's subjects.
The bearer of this ring is linked with the spirit world, and may channel the power of a deity.
A chest looted from the dingy treasury of the Syndicate. Its unassuming looks hide the secret weapons of their fight.

EffectInfo.name: Info
EffectInfo.description: Only usable in the Vault. Use to spawn a destructible chest containing rewards.

Object.Description: The Assassin gains more information using these knock-off Black Coins.
The Sorcerer gains more information using these knock-off Black Coins.
Usually pirate treasure is marked with an X on the map but it seems like The Tinkerer already found all of them!

A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.
A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

EffectInfo.description: Fires a sword of projectiles towards your cursor.
EffectInfo.name: Eternal Defender

Object.Description: Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.

EffectInfo.description: On use, lowers your shot speed by half for 4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Self Only

Object.Description: A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.
Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

EffectInfo.description: Fire 3 swords that pause and target the nearest enemy.
EffectInfo.name: Effect

Object.Description: This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

EffectInfo.description: Your weapon fires two more bullets, each dealing 50-65 damage.
EffectInfo.name: Effect

Object.Description: Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: When in combat, reduces your attack by 10.

Object.Description: An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.

EffectInfo.description: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 5%

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: When in combat, reduces your wisdom by 10.

Object.Description: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: When in combat, reduces your dexterity by 5.

Object.Description: The lavish robes of the kingdom's royalty, outfitted with pauldrons on both shoulders for a more distinguished appearance. A sinister presence remains channeled through the draping fabric.
Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.
Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.
An eerie reminder of what lies in the depths of the Shatters.

A peculiar stone, tremendously heavy for its size and seemingly not of this world. Its very presence in the realm raises a great deal more questions than answers, yet the uncanny energy it emanates provides only one haunting clue.

EffectInfo.description: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 15%

Object.Description: A colossal gauntlet of masterful composition. Its sheer size is disproportionate for most warriors, only able to be worn on one's forearm as a bracer. A once glossy exterior faded from battle long ago, yet the sturdiness of its make is as resolute as it ever was.
A staff of grisly, warped wood cradling a luminous green gemstone. It is said to be powered by souls trapped within the gem.
The skull of an alligator, used to house spirits summoned through wicked rituals.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a Ritual Circle for 6 seconds
Within 3 sqrs, 225-275 Damage at the radius, scaling up to 1350-1650 Damage at the center, every 1 second

EffectInfo.name: Fang Necklace
EffectInfo.description: The Ritual Circle gives Berserk within 3 sqrs

EffectInfo.name: Soul Gem Amulet
EffectInfo.description: The Ritual Circle inflicts Slowed within 3 sqrs

Object.Description: Robes pieced together from coarse, ragged cloth, adorned with decorative bones and cursed trinkets.
A necklace of fangs stolen from vicious swamp creatures. The predatory strength of the beasts empowers the wearer.

EffectInfo.name: Blood Offering
EffectInfo.description: Ritual Circle now also gives Berserk

Object.Description: An amulet housing a powerful soul. It calls out and draws wandering spirits towards the wearer.

EffectInfo.name: Soul Offering
EffectInfo.description: Ritual Circle now also inflicts Slowed

Object.Description: It croaks, you croak.

EffectInfo.name: Deadly Croak
EffectInfo.description: Throws a poison on shoot every 0.4 seconds dealing 500 damage over 1 second within 2 tiles. This poison provides has a 25% damage boost and Scales off attack.

Object.Description: Fully functional, but barely keeping itself together, users of this blowpipe benefit greatly from its powerful sting.
This garb is worse for wear, but users have reported a significant decrease in excruciating chemical burns.
Thick leather gloves allowing the user to handle the most toxic of materials, but harsh words still hurt the same.

EffectInfo.name: Toxicity
EffectInfo.description: Toxic Toad has a 5% chance to release another Poison Grenade

Object.Description: Can be used in the Forge to craft Shaman Necromancer Items.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Alchemist Assassin Items.

A heavily serrated blade set studded with thorns from the many ravenous plants of the Sulfurous Wetlands. The accursed magic used to mutate the native flora has been likewise imbued to these blades, enabling for a unique yet precise slashing technique.
This ornate herding staff composed of an old willow branch has been warped beyond mortal comprehension due to prolonged influence of the twisted beings of the Sulfurous Wetlands.
A sickly piece of armor, grown from the twisted bark from one of the few remaining Ent Ancients that still populate the Sulfurous Wetlands.

EffectInfo.description: Shooting while in combat grants healing for 4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: On player shoot

EffectInfo.description: Retaliates with a 150 damage lingering spore.
EffectInfo.name: On Hit

EffectInfo.description: Retaliates with a 175 damage + 75 damage over 4 second bleed
EffectInfo.name: On Shoot while In Combat

Object.Description: This necklace once signified the everlasting bond between two people. As if alive, this necklace carries with it an aura of spite and anguish.
A vial of purified bog water from the Sulfurous Wetlands. Though safe to drink, erratic magic has befouled this liquid to an unsavable state.
A bottle containing a mixture of ground Bloodflower petals and cleansed swamp water. Those who drink it feel rather invigorated yet feel chased by an ever-growing, ominous aura.
A peculiarly weathered rock with runes burned into it from generations of being submerged in the acidic bog. This makeshift snare is unmatched in power, but it activates on its own terms.

Placing this trinket into an appropriate slot found on Steamworks machines activates their overclock drastically increasing output. The increased speed causes a greater amount of wear on the parts of the machine, usage of this item is only authorized to higher ranking Kogbolds.

Efforts by lower workers of the kogbolds to arm themselves against invaders has resulted in various interesting crudely made armaments. Fashioned from the boiler of a steam generator, this staff projects its scalding vapors towards a target, cooking them alive.

Object.Description: This electrical rod is actually used to remove rust from machine parts through electrolysis. When used on a living or artificial creature however, the shock causes muscles to tense and circuits to go haywire, reducing the assailant's power.

EffectInfo.name: On Use
EffectInfo.description: Produces 4 explosions at the aim point.
Subsequent bursts deal decreasing damage over a wider area.

Object.Description: The oldest forms of automatic computing built by the Kogbolds were a far cry from the self improving artificial intelligence of the modern Core designs. Though its computation capabilities are lost to time, the matrix remains conveniently effective at distributing powerful surges of energy.

EffectInfo.name: Rev Up

The projectiles of this spellblade can achieve great speed when fired...after they spend a moment to get warmed up.

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 1
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text:
A long time ago, there was a princess of the great heavens. Still very young and early in her training, she chose not to speak to people and focused only on her work. She would refuse her mentor's advice to meet and become friends with the villagers. 

'It's a waste of my time' the princess would often say. 

One day, the princess would walk to her workshop and find a little orange fox at her doorway. 

'Why do you stand by my door every day?' the princess asked.
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 2
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text:
The fox nervously scratched its fur as it responded, 'Oh dear princess, I am a bored and tired fox, and I yearn for someone to play with!' 

'Then go into the woods and play with some other creatures. I am very busy,' replied the princess. 

'But princess, I am sick and weak, and I cannot catch up with the other creatures. I see the light that you make from your work every night, and would love to play with your dancing lights!' The fox would approach her with a wistful curiosity. 

The princess reaffirmed 'I will not play with you. Please go away and bother someone else.'
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 3
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text:
The fox worriedly spun in circles, chasing its tail. 'You are the only one with the dancing lights! If I don't get to play with you, I will cry and wail until you spend time with me!' 

'I don't want to play with foxes. Cry all you want, I will not come out to play with you,' and the princess would shut her door. 

The princess would continue her work, and ignored the fox at her doorway every morning. And every night, she would hear the wailing and howling of a lonely fox outside her door. Every day she would see the orange fox, and every night she would hear the howling of the fox outside.
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 4
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text:
One day, the princess tired herself out on a great project, and yearned for a good night's sleep. And when she heard the fox's crying, she decided that she had enough. She would pick a metal lantern from her workshop and walk out one night, looking for the fox. 

'Where are you?' the princess shouted. 'I am tired of your wailing and I need to sleep!' 

The fox stopped howling, and curiously approached. 'Have you come out to play with me?' 

'No! I am going to take my lantern and chase you far away from this village, so I can sleep without your howling!'
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 5
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text: The exhausted princess could not catch up to the fox as she chased it around the village. All around, the villagers awoke to the screaming of an angry princess accompanied by the happy yips of a fox. Every lantern lit up as villagers watched the fox joyfully lead the princess's lantern here and there and everywhere. \n\nThe princess tripped over her feet and dropped her lantern with a loud CLANG! And the fox would bite and pick up the lantern.
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.DisplayId: The Princess and the Fox: Page 6
Object.Description: A page from a book of an Eastern folktale.

Activate.text: 'Now it's my turn to hold the dancing light!' \n\nThe villagers watched with great interest at the sudden performance of the princess and the fox. The princess would spend all night chasing the fox for her lantern, until she was too tired and gave up. And the next night, the fox would sit there with her stolen lantern, waiting to play with the princess once again.
Activate.title: Princess and the Fox

Object.Description: This legendary dagger was commissioned by a band of mad rogues to prove the worth of the Dirk.
The cursed skull of a corrupted mind. Good intentions can go horribly wrong.
Fashioned from the finest logs found within the Woodland Labyrinths, this bow uses sharp leaves instead of conventional arrows. Such lightweight ammunition allows for quick movement.
A finely crafted leather bound quiver containing many small darts. The reduced size of the arrows in this quiver allow a specific firing pattern, confusing their target as if they were seeing double.
A seal granting the user access to other dimensions, though the means by which this is accomplished are unknown.
A mighty katana with a crystal eye embedded in the hilt.
A ring made from the eye of the Snake Queen.
Reinforced with magical hard candy from the candy forest. Sticky but strong.
Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.
A sword with an impossibly sharp edge. It has been designed with holy magic to slash like no other blade.
Use this chest to receive a random reward.
Use this chest to receive a random reward.
Use this chest to receive a random reward.
A candle-filled pumpkin attached to a gnarled stick using a length of vine. Very thematic for a spooky season of ghouls and goblins.\n\nSprite Credits: DynamoX

This longbow does not fire normal arrows. Instead each pull of the string creates an arrow which pierces the spirit of the target, and a sinister shadow which follows this divine projectile.\n\nSprite Credits: DynamoX
This skull-adorned shield was created to commemorate the Skeleton Kings with the wealth of many spare jaws at their distal phalanges.
These delightfully social spirits are willing to part for a swift scare, but they won't dare venture too far from their owner!
This wand can help you fall madly in love, with a heavy emphasis on the mad.
Anyone caught in the blast of this item find themselves longing for a lost love, a yearning which Incubi find delicious.
Made from the finest materials and tailored to show off the Incubus' physique.
The Incubus has real horns, but wearing these as well somehow makes him even more irresistible.

EffectInfo.description: 20% chance to spawn a decoy Fallen Cherub for five seconds.
EffectInfo.name: On Taking Damage

EffectInfo.description: 20% chance to spawn an Impcubus to aid you in combat for five seconds.
EffectInfo.name: On Taking Damage

EffectInfo.description: 200 damage every 0.5 seconds, within five tiles.
EffectInfo.name: Impcubus Combat

Object.Description: Affects allies around you. Boost your HP for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Smells like toothpaste.
Affects allies around you. Boost your MP for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Do not eat if allergic to nuts.
Affects allies around you. Boost your WIS for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Tastes like blueberries.
Affects allies around you. Boost your VIT for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Has the strong smell of fresh strawberries.
Affects allies around you. Boost your DEX for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Despite the name, they taste like orange.
Affects allies around you. Boost your SPD for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Has a really sour green apple flavor.

Affects allies around you. Boost your DEF for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. The taste is reminiscent of a very sugary fizzy drink.

Affects allies around you. Boost your ATT for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. While it does taste like grapes, no grapes are used when making it.
Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward.
Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward of higher value.
Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward of even higher value.
Unleash destruction with this brutal flail. Its massive anvil end shatters armor and crushes foes. Its craftsmanship whispers of an untamed, cataclysmic force.
Imbued with the untamed power of the Mighty Minotaur, this shield leaves a feeling of despair and no escape to those unfortunate enough to be in it's presence.
This mythical Minotaur chest plate infuses your weapon with a speed that mirrors the guardians of ancient labyrinths, making you the calm yet devastating eye of the cyclone in battle.
Slip on these savage Knuckles and unleash a whirlwind of swings, each powered by an uncanny dexterity that leaves foes questioning what hit them.
Unleash the untamed forces of electricity! This rod's damage output is as unpredictable as a storm, striking foes with bolts that range from a spark to a lightning blast.
Summons static Totems that discharge electrical bolts around it. The totem’s rapid fire makes it a formidable static defense.

EffectInfo.name: Totems
EffectInfo.description: deals x damage and paralyzes enemies for 0.3 seconds in a 5 tile area.

Object.Description: This mystical armor amplifies your defenses and imbues you with the swiftness needed for rapid totem placement.
This enchanted pendant heightens your elemental abilities and agility, enabling quick placement of Storm Totems and devastating attacks.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Mad Minotaur Items.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Storm Shaman Items.

From December 1st to the 25th, each day unwraps a new gift in your Gift Chest! Should you get this calendar after the 1st, gifts from previous days will be delivered to you in bulk. Trim up the tree with Oryxmas stuff, like mistletoe and big cream puffs!
All who stand against the merry melodies of the holiday season will be jingle bell ROCKED.
The hot wax of this candle burns with the judgement of those who lack a giving spirit.
This festive axe is meant to chop wood for a cozy winter fireplace, but it could probably handle your enemies in combat too.
Candy canes, candy canes, lick them in a spear and kill your enemies!
Great for stringing along doors, railings, or the nock of an arrow before releasing.

What was once a normal longbow wielded long ago has spent enough time frozen in shuffling layers of ice to become a mythical relic.
Light refracting through the crystalline tip of this spellblade is amplified to blinding degrees, though this is not the most powerful aspect of the weapon.
Held aloft, this magical focusing device will become charged with stellar power. It is favored by explorative types as it doubles as a compass.
This ball and chain of magical ice was dragged around by a helpless soul as the winter's chill seeped deeper and deeper into their cold, dead heart.
The beauty of these blades as they dance together, bathed in radiant light soothes the restless souls that they tear from the bodies of their victims. The joys of winter are many.

Legend has it that this precious gem is the crystallized essence of a fierce dragon's heart, imbued with the ancient magic that flows through the veins of these titanic creatures.

Object.Description: The gooey chocolate pellets attract the Hatchling, which fetches them back to the wielder along with bites taken out of whatever they are attached to.
The projectiles fired from this bio-mechanical weapon are so sticky that they glue themselves to the air for a moment before they start flying.
A solid ball of bio-chocolate on the end of a chain. It is so heavy and dense that when it lands it can shatter stone.

EffectInfo.name: Yolky Impact
EffectInfo.description: Causes an explosion dealing 330-395 damage when fired.

Object.Description: These Tachi are made to mimic the flopped ears of an Easter Bunny, and they fly back towards the thrower in imitation of them too.
This severed tail of an Easter Queen can continue to produce molten chocolate at flesh-searing temperatures long after it has been cut free.

EffectInfo.name: Chocolate Pools
EffectInfo.description: Creates a puddle of boiling chocolate when fired.

Object.Description: A rapid-firing cannon which hurls handfuls of broken Easter Egg shell at the victim, lacerating them with the sharp edges.

Object.Description: Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

EffectInfo.description: Fire 3 swords that pause and target the nearest enemy.
EffectInfo.name: Effect

Object.Description: Dr. Terrible modeled this staff in the likeness of his creation as an experimental attachment to the M.E.R.V. design. To prevent overheating, the unstable energy discharges require a moment to cool.
Seemingly bleak at first, this prism has erratic magical properties looming inside, which affect the light it scatters in unforeseen ways.
A barrel filled to the brim with the cheapest ale money can buy. The cask is highly pressurized and must be handled with care, should it be dropped it is likely to explode violently.
The crystalline glass in this orb seals away an ancient flora said to rejuvenate the spirit and unleash one's force of will against those who threaten the wild.

EffectInfo.description: Grant Berserk to self and allies within 6 tiles for 5 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Consume 50 Hex on an enemy

EffectInfo.description: Gain a 4/7/10/12 Dex buff for 5 seconds depending on the amount of stacks consumed.
EffectInfo.name: Every 25 Hex Consumed

Object.Description: Open the chest to get a random reward!
Open the chest and select a reward of your choosing!
An intricately crafted vessel, usually used to store the preserved internal organs, but this one seems to contain a cursed diety.
Crafted by a soul newly ensnared in the clutches of darkness, its design invoked memories of the fiery wrath of the god of chaos

EffectInfo.name: Explosion Scaling
EffectInfo.description: +10 damage and +0.1 sqrs per WIS above 50.

Object.Description: This ancient spell scroll, adorned with intricate hieroglyphs depicting the sinuous forms of cobras, invokes the power of the serpentine deities. Whispering secrets of venomous potency.
Crafted from glistening ivory and adorned with shimmering gold, but seems carry an ancient protection spell coming from the Underworld.
This dagger arcs gracefully like the crescent moon.
Adorned in gold jewels and vibrant Egyptian blue, only the most skilled archers were given the right to wield such a magnificent bow.
This staff is rumored to have devastating power when under the influence of an eclipse.
The power of this rod comes from the glimmering glow of the sun, when shinned on top of the highest pyramid its power will really show.
Iconic to ancient Egypt, this curved blade was both used in warfare and ceremonies.
This blade gleams brightly blinding foes with every swing.
A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.
Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

EffectInfo.description: Inflicts a poison within 4 squares dealing 750 damage over 3.6 seconds.
Enemies under the effect of the poison receive 12% more damage from you, scaling with DEX.
Damage boost is increased by 7% for every 10 DEX above 50.

Object.Description: An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons that last for 5 seconds and chases enemies
EffectInfo.name: Summons

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons with 1500 HP that last for 10 seconds and protects the user.
EffectInfo.name: Summons

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons heal 50 HP within 5 squares upon decaying.
EffectInfo.name: Ash and Dust

Object.Description: A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

Survival of the fittest.
Survival of the fittest.

A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.

EffectInfo.description: Conjure mysterious runes that deal 110-160 damage every 0.6 seconds to enemies within 5 squares, lasting 6 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Rune Carvings

Object.Description: A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

EffectInfo.description: Consumes most of your available MP upon casting the poison. The greater the amount of MP consumed the more potent the explosion.
EffectInfo.name: Arcane Nourishment

EffectInfo.description: Pollen lingers within 10 squares of ground zero, dealing 120-200 damage.

Object.Description: A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

EffectInfo.description: Sick on self when in combat. Gain an ATK boost the lower your HP is.
EffectInfo.name: On Shoot

Object.Description: An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.

EffectInfo.description: While holding down the ability key, drain 50 MP/sec and become Weakened.
While holding down the ability key, release a stream of bubbles whilst shooting scaling with your Lethal Strike Damage.
+60 damage and 10% of the enemies defense as damage.
EffectInfo.name: Lethal Strike

EffectInfo.description: +1 flat damage and +1% of the enemies defense per wis over 34.
EffectInfo.name: Lethal strike scaling

Object.Description: Inhale, exhale.
Inhale, exhale.
A fishing rod fashioned from a tree branch and string. It is suitable for beginners.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a controllable fishing line and aim at ripples on the water to catch fish!
This can only be used at the fish pond in the Coral Reefs biome.

Object.Description: A sturdy fishing rod reinforced with metal. It is an adequate tool for any and all fishing activities.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a controllable fishing line and aim at ripples on the water to catch fish!
This can only be used at the fish pond in the Coral Reefs biome.

Object.Description: A fishing rod with a steel alloy frame. Its light weight allows for faster casting.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a controllable fishing line and aim at ripples on the water to catch fish!
This can only be used at the fish pond in the Coral Reefs biome.

Object.Description: A fishing rod used by master fishers. It requires skill and precision to use to its full potential.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a controllable fishing line and aim at ripples on the water to catch fish!
This can only be used at the fish pond in the Coral Reefs biome.

Object.Description: A legendary fishing rod only passed down to those who are worthy. It is unrivalled in effectiveness.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a controllable fishing line and aim at ripples on the water to catch fish!
This can only be used at the fish pond in the Coral Reefs biome.

Object.Description: Call forth a cute frog companion!
Call forth a cute squid companion!
Call forth a cute crab companion!

Object.Description: A foreign sheath stolen from unknown lands by the crew of Davy Jones. Now phantoms, the headstrong ghost pirates have misused this delicate instrument as a rapier holder, twisting its effects with their chaotic ways.
Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.

EffectInfo.name: Summons
EffectInfo.description: Wandering steed, click or hold your Summon Control button to move it.

Object.Description: An astronomically heavy katana. It is forged from dark matter.
The gouged eye of the ferocious F.E.R.A.L. It is no longer potent enough to generate energy beams, but the beast's psychic vision still instinctively lashes back at aggressors.

EffectInfo.name: On Taking Damage
EffectInfo.description: 40% chance to Slow enemies within 6 tiles for 5 seconds.

Object.Description: A glacial robe worn by the witch doctors of a bygone ice tribe during their sacred burial ceremonies. The passage of time has encased the cloth in a layer of permafrost, chilling those who fracture its coat.
Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.
Coral from the depths of the ocean which has formed into a natural ring. Painful to put on and take off, but very rare and therefore desirable.
An ancient ship's bell encrusted with dried deep kelp and bearing obscure sigils of forgotten, underwater gods. Its peals can summon fish to defend the bearer, but at what cost?

EffectInfo.description: Summons a ghostly fish attack your enemies.
EffectInfo.name: Deep Pact

EffectInfo.description: 5% chance upon shooting for a ghostly fish to protect you for 3 seconds
EffectInfo.name: Unearthly Clang

Object.Description: A rusted piece of Kogbold machinery recovered from the depths of the ocean. The only question is, how did it get on a thousand-year-old shipwreck?
Ancient legends say that the Phantom Diver never misses when he tosses this terrible harpoon. The fact these legends cannot be traced back to before last week is not important.
A surprisingly modern explosive for breaching boats below the waterline. Don't forget to run when you throw it to avoid the blast!
The glowing tatters of an old diving suit. The wearer must be a spooky ghost, and not three Kogbolds standing on each other's shoulders.
Thick, lead ingots used to keep a diver's feet on the floor. They are definitely not gold bars being smuggled out of a secret mine.
Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.
This shimmering shield allows knights to enhance their concentration on targets, giving them more time to think about their next move in battle.
A wakizashi used by a powerful swordsman in ancient times. It seems to dance through the air as you swing it.
Believed to have been lost in a bygone era, this spell was recovered from ruins infested by horrific creatures of unknown origin. The scroll is still steeped with parasitic organisms.
A thin hood with a faded golden lace worn for sacrificial ceremonies. It has an aura of evil around it.
This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

EffectInfo.description: Your weapon fires three more bullets, each dealing 65-80 plus 1 for every 2 Dex over 60 damage.
EffectInfo.name: Effect

Object.Description: Open this shell to receive a random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.
Open this shell to receive a better random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.

Open this shell to receive an even better random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.
Use this chest to receive a random reward.
Made from Superburger and Spice of Life. This ultimate burger, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
Made from Oryx Cookie and Spice of Life. This ultimate cookie, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
Made from Power Pizza and Spice of Life. This ultimate slice of pizza, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.
Use this chest to obtain a class mystery skin of choice!
This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky. It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.

Object.id: Helm of the Juggernaut Shiny - Midas
Object.Description: This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky. It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.
This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.

EffectInfo.name: On Ability use with full meter
EffectInfo.description: Hits with Vampire Blast Purify status effects within 3.25 Squares

Meter.chargeString: Charge the meter by healing with your Raised Dead!

Object.Description: A fragment of Lord Ruthven's curse manifest itself into this pulsating dagger. Its formless state allows it to cut in ways no other weapon could.

Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: When in combat, reduces your dexterity by 5.

Object.Description: A mysterious quiver formed of corruption and dark matter. Its ethereal existence creates a small implosion of nearby atmosphere when drawn.
Decorated with ancient amber, this helmet's idle solitude over many years have caused its abilities to dwindle.
Her blade of choice was cursed to be unfit to harm the likes of gods. Through accursed soul binding, she found a means to adapt this curse into a terrifying weapon.

The death throes of a powerful demigod remain sealed within the crystalline exterior, but are briefly unleashed as the soul desperately attempts to cling onto life, pulling onto the life force of nearby souls only to strengthen its prison further.

EffectInfo.description: Deal 1000 damage to enemies within 5 tiles.
EffectInfo.name: Ether Purge

EffectInfo.description: Heal 75 hit points for each enemy hit.
EffectInfo.name: Soul Drain

Object.Description: A well-worn studded leather that has witnessed many battles and many more losses. It is the common wear of those who must bear the burden of burying those forever lost to the fight against the gods.

EffectInfo.description: Gain 5/10/15/20 defense for 5 seconds on ability use.
EffectInfo.name: Grave Resistance

EffectInfo.description: Empower with additional Spellbound Soulthief items.
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: Concentrated within this gemstone are souls of vengeance, burning to serve one final role to smite the oppressors of the living.

EffectInfo.description: Retaliate every 0.4s with soul blades for 300-350 armor piercing damage.
EffectInfo.name: Blade Waltz

EffectInfo.description: Empower with Armored effect, wearing Blade of Fates, or both.
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: A pristine cloud of nebular stardust gently rests atop a focusing rod in a tranquil stasis, until it is catalyzed into a microscopic genesis of stellar proportions. It is a reminder of the thin divide between uncreation and creation, a transcendental dance of the cosmos.

A glassy projection of arcanic lights provide an accurate chart of the stars beyond the Realm. Through a careful process of measurement and divination, one can travel along ley lines of starlight to reach worlds unknown.

EffectInfo.description: Emit flaming stars for 185-315 damage plus 1 damage for every ATT over 50.
EffectInfo.name: Star Fire

EffectInfo.description: Curse enemies for 4 seconds within 5.6 tiles.
EffectInfo.name: Solar Flare

EffectInfo.description: Duration increases to 6.5 seconds while wearing Nebular Rod
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: What was once the simple vestments of an astronomer have become a curtain of stardust and dreams, a priceless record of countless travel through worlds that may never be visited again.

EffectInfo.description: Duration is 5.6 seconds while wearing Eye of Divination.
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: A crystalline formation in the shape of an eye remains the sole artifact of the journey’s true purpose- a secret beyond the stars waiting to be discovered. Beyond the dark horizons of the cosmic plane, what else has Cronus left behind for the explorers of the present to discover?
Can be used in the Forge to craft Spellbound Soulthief Trickster Items.
Can be used in the Forge to craft Astral Arcanist Mystic Items.
A legendary weapon whose attacks are said to be as intense as its red color. Rumor has it that this may not even be the original.
Another orb in an endless myriad of orbs for heroes to collect. What makes this specific shape so special?

EffectInfo.description: Emit flaming stars for 185-315 damage plus 1 damage for every ATT over 50.
EffectInfo.name: Star Fire

EffectInfo.description: Curse enemies for 4 seconds within 5.6 tiles.
EffectInfo.name: Solar Flare

EffectInfo.description: Duration increases to 6.5 seconds while wearing Monochrome Staff
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: No matter how you look at this garment, it is always distinctly black and red, with no in-between shades.

EffectInfo.description: Duration is 5.6 seconds while wearing Strange Ring.
EffectInfo.name: Empowerment

Object.Description: It is hard to make out what is on top of this ring. Maybe it is an eye or some sort of gem?
This covering is assigned to Oryx's negotiators to conceal weaponry and get away with stolen fortunes.
The diplomacy of Chancellor Dammah goes as far as his limited patience. The true purpose of this robe is its deeply woven enchantment to bolster arcane powers.

EffectInfo.name: On Ability
EffectInfo.description: Summon a portal which deals 125 damage and zaps enemies in a radius of 5 every 0.4 seconds

EffectInfo.name: On Ability Use
EffectInfo.description: Boosts attack by 15 and decreases defense by 6 for 5 seconds

Object.Description: This cursed robe overwhelms the wearer with conflicting thoughts of good and evil, shattering the will of the weak-minded.
Specially weighted plates layered inside this armor channel greater force into every motion of the body for destructive blows.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: Increases attack by 12 for 4.5 seconds if the user has the Healing status effect

Object.Description: Although refurbished, this breastplate is the very same Oryx received as a gift from the royal family in celebration of his gladiatorial prowess.
An arachnid star which slings silk to tangle predators while granting oneself the speed and stamina of Arachna's most agile young.

Object.id: Cloak of the Mad God Shiny
Object.Description: A pitch black cloak enhanced with the defensive strength of Oryx's own signature armor.

EffectInfo.description: Fire 2 additional projectiles dealing damage equal to your Lethal Strike damage for 2.4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: After exiting sneak

EffectInfo.description: Grants the Armored buff for 5 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Shooting with lethal strike

Object.Description: An intricate scepter of unfathomable power containing the electric fluids of a jellyfish behemoth.
A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.
A large spinel hanging from a glittering gold chain.

EffectInfo.name: Glory Amulet
EffectInfo.description: Creates effects when worn with MotMG 2024 equipment.

EffectInfo.name: Weapons
EffectInfo.description: The weapon fires 2 extra projectiles with 80% range, dealing 55-75 Armor Piercing damage.

EffectInfo.name: Armours
EffectInfo.description: Applies Healing condition for 8 seconds on hit, 20 seconds cooldown.

Object.Description: A tried and tested weapon used extensively by Commander-Lord Carosburg's soldiers. It has a good weight for chopping, and a fine edge which can slice through most armour.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity

Object.Description: Cronus made many prototypes for different wands, with this being one of his most popular amongst his students, as the shots can injure a target in the past as well as the present.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: A swift and deadly dagger used as a backup weapon by soldiers in Commander-Lord Carosburg's armies. It is also very useful by itself, and has ended many lives on the battlefield.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: While it appears to the untrained eye that this bow only fires three arrows, it actually fires hundreds across all dimensions, as Cronus designed it to hit every possible variation of the target.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: Out of respect for their missing teacher, students of Cronus will mount a stone mask of his face to a staff to use as a focus. They will often wear these masks or use them as ornaments as well.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: A frighteningly sharp blade from the eastern lands, modified for use in Commander-Lord Carosburg's forces by executioners and elite duellists.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates additional projectiles when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: Balanced between might and mysticism, the leather and metal of this light armour provides good protection and mobility.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: Polished to a high sheen, these banded plates proudly announce the prowess of the wearer in battle. Only the best of Commander-Lord Carosburg's foot troops are qualified to wear them.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

Object.Description: Robes which signify the wearer follows the wisdom of the missing magus – Chronus. The small death masks worn as charms are said to symbolise his teachings.

EffectInfo.name: Amulet Affinity
EffectInfo.description: Creates an on-hit effect when worn with an Amulet.

This brilliant diamond exhibits a peculiar agitation to exposure beyond the waters. It was plundered by the Pirate Queen herself from depths far deeper than the open seas, as it was believed to be the boon of an ancient oceanic deity.

EffectInfo.name: Summons
EffectInfo.description: Crown Jewel, follows your character as you move.

Object.Description: This sacred blade may be unsheathed in the blink of an eye to produce a catastrophic blast of lightning. Such a tool is used by Izel to bring fervor and great respect to the many gods of the thicket.

A depraved aura of malignance exudes from this relic. Once protected within the great tombs of the desert, Nefret unearthed this treasure to prevent it and many others from falling into the hands of the Legion.

EffectInfo.name: Summons
EffectInfo.description: Forbidden Orb, follows your cursor attacking enemies and pulsing damage.

Object.Description: Once nameless tools of an oni warrior, these blades have witnessed the bloodshed of a thousand lives lost to Oryx. They carry the whispers of a long-sought vengeance against the Exalted One.

Object.Description: A famous boxer once said the secret to their victory was having a great right hook, this dagger’s craftsman took that literally.
A ceremonial pungi that contains the spirits of fifteen snakes, guiding the righteous through their many paths ahead.
A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.
A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

EffectInfo.description: Fires a sword of projectiles towards your cursor.
EffectInfo.name: Eternal Defender

Object.Description: Cut from a fallen star, a deep purple emanating an unearthly glow, hinting at the power fused within.

EffectInfo.description: Fire a 4 projectile beam, dealing 111 armor piercing damage per shot.

Object.Description: How can something with so many holes in it be useful in defence? By spinning it so quickly nobody can strike you through the holes, of course!
This ancient, cursed treasure map causes treasure to appear in front of the caster. As the coins and jewels overlap in physical space this causes a massive explosion.
Pirates will not admit it, but they can't recall all the rules and regulations of piracy. So they write them all down in books like these which become sacred relics of piracy.
Arrows placed in this quiver become encrusted with a layer of sea salt, and turn into augurs of seawater when fired.
Some say this skull is the model used in the original Jolly Roger, but that seems a little unlikely. It is still super powerful, whatever the truth.

Use this bag to receive a random spooky reward.
Shaping raw magic into spirit-like forms, phantasmal projectiles are launched, each one homing in on the target with the precision of a well trained archer.

EffectInfo.description: Obtained by entertaining Soulwarden Murcian in the Spectral Penitentiary
EffectInfo.name: Drop location

Object.Description: A luminescent vial containing an eerie liquid, extracted through the complete pulverization of a soul.

EffectInfo.name: Forge

EffectInfo.description: Obtained as a drop from enemies in the Spectral Penitentiary.
EffectInfo.name: Drop location

Object.Description: A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.
Two of Groundskeeper Gretch's most coveted tools, tainted by a powerful curse that draws out the life essence of its user to maintain their finesse.
A tattered piece of cloth crudely fashioned into a robe, barely capable of covering its wearer. However, what it lacks in physical durability is made up with a thick barrier of mana.

An extremely heavy axehead salvaged from Griefkeeper Zole's rather bulky choice of weaponry. Throwing it takes a tremendous amount of effort, but it has the capacity to obliterate everything in its path.

EffectInfo.description: Launches a giant projectile with 7 hitboxes
EffectInfo.name: Unstoppable Force

EffectInfo.description: On shooting after ability use, restore 2MP/shot for 5s.
EffectInfo.name: Relentless Recharge

Object.Description: A faintly magical device used by Griefkeeper Zole to amplify his own voice throughout the Penitentiary's cell branch. Peculiarly, speaking into it warps any attempts at encouragement into toxic insults.

EffectInfo.description: Buffs are centered on cursor instead of on user
EffectInfo.name: Long-Range Assault

Object.Description: A chilling metal container filled with miscellaneous medical instruments coated in poison. Its syringes require blood as a catalyst, taking a considerable toll on both victim and user alike.

EffectInfo.description: Spend 3 HP/shot to fire a deadly needle
On key press and release, spend 30 MP for Healing on self for 2s
EffectInfo.name: Surgical Maneuver

EffectInfo.description: Spend 10 MP/shot to heal 12 HP when below 90% HP

Object.Description: A tightly-woven garment used to restrain the mentally insane in the Penitentiary's torture branch. The echoed laughs of its past users can be faintly heard while wearing it, and intensify as its wearer takes damage.

EffectInfo.description: On shoot, 1% chance to be inflicted with any of the following effects for 3s
EffectInfo.name: Generalized Insanity

Object.Description: The incredibly thick cornea taken from the eye of Overseer Oculon. It bears an immense hunger for magical energy, and will devour its user's entire mana pool in the blink of an eye.

EffectInfo.description: Unleash an additional burst of poison on the enemy dealing 500 damage plus 1 for every mana over 300 within 3 squares. Increased by 150 damage and 1 tile radius every 25 stacks.
EffectInfo.name: Consume 25 Hex

Object.Description: A questionably sentient artifact smuggled from the Penitentiary's administration branch. Repeatedly irritating the summoned entity causes it to spew corrosive tears in a large area.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a lingering eyebawl that lasts for 10 seconds
EffectInfo.name: Eyebawl Toss

EffectInfo.description: Upon repeated throws targeting an Eyebawl, it deals 1200 damage within 6 sqrs

Object.Description: An uncannily heavy iron ball and chain utilized by Murcian himself, burdened by the weight of countless souls that met their fate at the hands of the warden.

EffectInfo.description: On shooting above 99% HP, -50 VIT for 3s
EffectInfo.name: Heavy Conscience

EffectInfo.description: On shooting under 66% HP, gain Armored and +10 ATT for 6s
EffectInfo.name: Point of No Return

Object.Description: A much more refined cane than its predecessor, imbued with unwilling spirits that lost their way towards the afterlife.

EffectInfo.description: 15% chance with a 0.6 second cooldown to release a Desperate Soul
EffectInfo.name: On Shoot

EffectInfo.description: Drifts away after 6 seconds, inflicting Curse on nearby enemies
EffectInfo.name: Soul Release

Object.Description: A specially engineered concoction containing a modified plague virus, allowing the direct infection of a victim's soul. Although it can infect over a massive area, the particular lack of lethality makes it seem incomplete.
Empowering the mystic gem embedded in this armor caused it to violently disintegrate its former shell. Fitted into a new plating, it now massively increases its wielder's capacity for magical energy.

EffectInfo.description: On taking more than 40 damage gain Energized for 3 seconds
EffectInfo.name: Soul Flare

Object.Description: A nearly restored version of a once historical amulet, with the previous gem resocketed into a new metallic frame. It seems to have regained more of its ancient power.

EffectInfo.description: On taking damage when below 20% HP gain Invulnerable for 2 seconds and heal 120 HP
EffectInfo.name: Soul Concentration

EffectInfo.description: On shooting below 20% HP gain Healing, Berserk and Armored for 4 seconds
EffectInfo.name: Last Stand

Object.Description: Once a mystical artifact that allowed its bearer to escape the grasp of death, this amulet remains as a relic of Murcian's past involvement with Skuld. Wearing this amulet is ill-advised.

Summons Murcian and his staff to follow you around the realm! Wait a second, how did they escape...?\n\nRewarded to Marshmalla, TLMaelstrom, Sheepsmall, and Idontgiveawhale for their work on Spectral Penitentiary.
An infinite generator for the Spectral Penitentiary contributor reward.
An ominous looking safe from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.

EffectInfo.description: Only usable in the Vault. Use to spawn a destructible chest containing rewards.

Object.Description: A bowl filled with rewarding soup. You're not quite sure what's inside, but getting it down your stomach makes you feel tough enough to do involuntary labor.

Object.Description: It is little known that Biff used to have an extra head. It holds secrets of untold treasures. \n\nItems contained in Biff’s Secrets can only be redeemed until the 20th of May 2025.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the K.I.D.D. Force to create the K.I.D.D. Force 2.0. Upgraded with even less shades, this staff has really come around.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the MMace MMurderer to create the FFabulous FFlail. A MMace that can be MMasterfully FFlung, FFrequently FFlying FFabulously albeit with slight miscalculations.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of Mister Mango to create the Groovy Mango. This jamming mango was given the time to sweeten and ripen into a groovy party rocking entity.
After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Butter Bow to create the Baked Bow. This bow showcases the power of butter, enjoy these tasty baked treats.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Caduceus of Current Craziness to create the Caduceus Of Enlightened Chaos. Using this wand allows the user to reach their full chaotic potential and understand their role in battle; be unpredictable and let someone else deal with it.

After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Blade of Ages to create the Blade of Blooming. Nature would slowly takeover this blade blooming with beautiful roses.
All that glitters is not gold. Beware, tricksters who choose this dastardly prism must be committed to their cruel prank.
