Object.Description: With the stone pickaxe, you can break the stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the iron pickaxe, you can break the iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the emerald pickaxe, you can break the emerald, iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).

With the diamond pickaxe, you can break the diamond, emerald, iron and stone ores found throughout the Realm! To do so, use your character's special ability and move the pickaxe by pressing the mouse wheel (default keybind).
This shovel reveals secrets lost under the surface of the realm.
This chisel carves through a wide variety of materials in search of new information about the realm's forgotten past.
A heavy hammer designed for multiple uses, like smashing enemies, breaking through walls, and forging new tools.
A tray to store materials, precious stones, and relics that were found.
An explosive that not only uncovers hidden paths but also deals damage to enemies.
A torch that lights up the depths of the realm, revealing secrets hidden in the darkness.
An enigmatic chest filled with various trinkets and materials. Perfect for those who crave the thrill of the unknown.
A bundle of weapons to choose from - rumored to possess magical properties and crafted from superior materials, though no one knows for certain.
A chest of rare spoils from across the Realm, but those who covet it often pay a price.
Contains four units of Green Dust Gem.
Contains two units of Green Dust Gem.
Contains two units of Red Dust Gem.

Choose 1 reward:
*Purple Dust Philosopher's Geode (fills Purple Dust storage to maximum when consumed)
*Red Dust Philosopher's Geode (fills Red Dust storage to maximum when consumed)
*Green Dust Philosopher's Geode (fills Green Dust storage to maximum when consumed)

Choose 1 reward:
*Purple Dust Gem (500 Purple Dust)
*Double Red Dust Gem Pack (1,000 Red Dust)
*Quadruple Green Dust Gem Pack (2,000 Green Dust)

Choose 1 reward:
*Purple Dust Essence (250 Purple Dust)
*Red Dust Gem (500 Red Dust)
*Green Dust Gem Pack (1,000 Green Dust)

Choose 1 reward:
*Purple Dust Shard (125 Purple Dust)
*Red Dust Essence (250 Red Dust)
*Green Dust Gem (500 Green Dust)
It contains valuable items very useful during Enchanting.
A magical rock that cracks open to reveal endless Dust within. Use to fill the storage of Purple Dust to the limit.\n\nConsumed when used.
A magical rock that cracks open to reveal endless Dust within. Use to fill the storage of Red Dust to the limit.\n\nConsumed when used.
A magical rock that cracks open to reveal endless Dust within. Use to fill the storage of Green Dust to the limit.\n\nConsumed when used.

EffectInfo.name: First activation
EffectInfo.description: Mark the location creating a Berserk aura in a radius of 3.

EffectInfo.name: Second activation
EffectInfo.description: Teleport back to the marked location exploding the previous mark dealing 1000 damage and granting Armored for 5 seconds in a radius of 5.

EffectInfo.name: Note
EffectInfo.description: Mark is reset upon changing area or after 8 seconds.

Object.Description: A fragmented prism that is constantly mending its cracks and refracturing. Pulling pieces apart can create an unstable link between two spaces as the prism tries to become whole again.
A hardy slab of ice wounded with crude markings on its surface. Passionate wedding vows are faintly readable.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a giant icicle that bursts into several projectiles after 1 second.
12 Shots: 100 AP DMG. Inflicts 5% DMG Vuln for 5 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Small Shards

Object.Description: A grand looking chest from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.

EffectInfo.name: Info
EffectInfo.description: Only usable in the Vault. Use to spawn a destructible chest containing rewards.

Object.Description: An ancient ceremonial robe once worn by the Tlatoani.
The azure stone makes you feel ready for any situation.
A silky case of arrows woven by Mama Megamoth's larvae for use by her woodland warriors.

The Woodland Labyrinth is a lamentable example of mortal meddling in the ways of nature, a harsh reality its occupants are keenly aware of. A sheath like this, fully embracing their own ways of life, is no doubt a bitter expression of dissent.
The frostbitten winds whisper her name, and the blades sing of her sorrow.
As the heavens decreed, the age of dragons came swiftly to an end. Yet the gaze of the mighty watch intensely over the world, waiting for the power of Draconis to rise once again.

EffectInfo.name: Summons
EffectInfo.description: Gaze of Draconis, follows your cursor attacking enemies and pulsing damage.

Object.Description: Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.

EffectInfo.description: On use, lowers your shot speed by half for 4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Self Only

Object.Description: Launch refreshing water balloons! They heal nearby players, damage enemies, and extinguish fires caused by heatwaves...

EffectInfo.description: A consumable that can be stored in the quick slot, has a 0.5 second cooldown and a max stack of 9.
When activated, it is thrown 3 tiles away in the current direction with a 0.25 s throw time.
Heals 75 HP to all players within 7.5 tiles.
500 area damage within 7.5 tiles. It deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem if it is cast directly on the totem.

Object.Description: A solid shovel perfect for sandcastles or smacking enemies in the face! While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: Dual frozen treats with a sweet bite! Sticky and surprisingly lethal. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: A powerful gun that blasts refreshing water! Perfect for cooling off and fighting enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: Protect yourself from the sun and heat with this umbrella, or use it to defeat some enemies that want to steal your place at the Realm's beach. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: These aren't just for walking on burning sand, they also deliver surprisingly splashy attacks to enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: Long and flexible, this noodle isn't just for the pool, it's perfect for delivering powerful, splashy hits. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

EffectInfo.name: Extra Water Burst
EffectInfo.description: 250 area damage within 4 tiles, deals more damage to the Realm Wood Totem

Object.Description: A bright orange vest designed to keep you afloat in deep water or on the battlefield.
A lightweight, bright outfit perfect for warm weather. It allows great freedom of movement and keeps you cool during intense battles.
A colorful inflatable made for floating, surprisingly useful in battle. Designed for summer rest, but it also offers just enough support to survive intense encounters in the Realm.
A hat that shields you from the blazing sun and heat, perfect for staying cool in the Realm.
A fizzy drink not just for beating the heat, use it to blast enemies with carbonated shots!
A chocolate popsicle not just for beating the heat, wield it in the Realm to deliver frosty pain!
A sour drink not just for refreshment, splash your enemies with citrus power straight from the bottle!
A strange ectoplasmic concoction that can inflict its blight on living and ethereal alike.
A masterpiece of craftsmanship, this full helm was forged in the fires of the volcanic abyss infusing its metal with a regenerative ability.
This armor is donned by the Brutes of the Abyss, focusing narrowly on pure offensive power with little regard to the wellbeing of its wearer.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot Below 90% HP
EffectInfo.description: Gain 3 ATT for 5 seconds, this bonus increases to 6 under 70% HP and 9 under 50% HP.

Object.Description: Stolen from the Queen Bee herself, this scepter possesses the power to destroy evil.
A relic uncovered from the depths of the jungle. It exudes a deep darkness.
A seal made from the Marble Colossus' head. The power of a pure and mighty paladin still remains within.

EffectInfo.description: Summon an Eye of Marble for 4.5 seconds

Object.Description: A historical amulet that has been passed down for generations. Although once cursed in the past, it still holds a hint of its ancient power.

EffectInfo.description: On taking damage when below 20% HP, gain 120 HP.
EffectInfo.name: Forgotten Power

Object.Description: The perfect tool for dismembering theatre equipment.

EffectInfo.name: Fires an additional shot every 2 seconds that deals 200-300 damage and exposes for 1 second.

Object.Description: A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.
Woven from the shrouds of fallen warlocks and bound with arcane sigils, this robe pulses with ancient power.
Crafted from shadow-infused hide and reinforced with silent steel, this armor grants uncanny agility and resilience to those who strike from the darkness.
Forged in the heart of a cursed forge, this blackened plate bears the scars of countless battles.
A razor-thin blade forged from obsidian and voidsteel, this dagger strikes faster than a shadow's blink. Its edge is in a constant thrist for blood.
Constructed from legendary blackwood and bone, this bow fires arrows that whisper through the air like wailing spirits. It is said each shot carries the wrath of a fallen legionnaire.
This gnarled staff hums with dark energy, its crystal core bound to the souls of ancient battlemages. Spells cast through it erupt with volatile force.
A wand carved from the heartwood of a cursed tree and tipped with an eternal ember.
This massive blade radiates dread with every swing. Enchanted to rend armor and bone alike.
Tempered in cursed flame and etched with forgotten runes, this katana channels the fury of the Legion's eastern assassins. Every slash cleaves both flesh and spirit.
A wand created from the wood of Sprite trees. Seems to be poorly calibrated, though.
A tight fitting garment of snake skin that is both functional and stylish.
A youthful jellyfish taken from the reefs of the ocean realms, residing within a coralglass jar.
A small golden band meant to be worn on one’s ear. This mundane looking accessory appears to give the wearer an increased tolerance to intoxicants.
Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.
Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.

EffectInfo.name: On Shoot
EffectInfo.description: When in combat, gain invulnerable for 1.6 seconds.

Object.Description: Grants stealth and deadly ambush power, favored by legion rogues.

EffectInfo.description: Fire 2 additional projectiles dealing damage equal to your Lethal Strike damage for 2.4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: After exiting sneak

Object.Description: Harnesses the refined precision of Legion Elite training, launching piercing shots that embody tactical mastery and relentless discipline.
Unleashes powerful dark magic, overwhelming foes with ordered chaos.
A corrupted tome pulsing with dark power, used by the Legion Elite to sustain their twisted forces and prolong their ruthless crusade.
A steel and obsidian helm of grim design, only worn by high commanders of the Shadow Legion.
A fortified shield forged in the abyssal forges of the Shadow Legion, built to withstand the fury of rebellion and enforce the will of their dark empire.
A seal of iron command, forged by the Shadow Legion to impose unwavering discipline and bolster their ranks with oppressive might.
Precision-crafted toxin designed for silent elimination behind enemy lines.
A cursed artifact channeling disciplined death magic to drain and heal.

Meter.chargeString: Charge the meter by healing with your Raised Dead!

Object.Description: Strikes with targeted lightning, controlling the battlefield with calculated force.
A deadly projectile of concentrated chi, launched with elite discipline.
A wicked wakizashi forged from shadowsteel, granted to Shadow Legion warlords as a reward for their ruthless conquest.
A darkly ornate sheath, relic of a fallen clan extinguished by the Shadow Legion, preserving deadly secrets of forgotten martial rites.
Mechanized snares designed for strategic area denial and rapid ambush.
Beats of war that rally allies and demoralize the unprepared.
Manipulates reality with disciplined chaos, disrupting the rebellion's formations.
Projects disciplined illusions, confounding enemies with strategic misdirection.
A brutal mace forged from cursed darksteel, imbued with the Shadow Legion's relentless fury and the unyielding force of their shadowed dominion.

EffectInfo.name: Summons
EffectInfo.description: Wandering Legion Elite, click or hold your Summon Control button to move it.

Object.Description: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Legion of Oryx Skins Collection.
A sealed cache of spoils seized by Oryx's most elite forces during one of their campaigns.
An immaculate Nightmatter Core set in a housing that acts as a conduit granting power to its wearer, the power grows even stronger in the presence of additional nightmatter.

EffectInfo.name: Enigmatic Lifeline
EffectInfo.description: Restores 300 HP when taking damage when below 50% HP.

EffectInfo.name: Mystic Restoration
EffectInfo.description: 50% on ability use to gain energized for 10 seconds.

EffectInfo.name: Rapid Decay
EffectInfo.description: On ability use poison enemies within 6 tiles, inflicting 1000 damage and causing them to take 5% more damage from you for 5 seconds.

Object.Description: A bowl of steamed perfection. Simple yet satisfying, it's rumored to restore energy faster than you can say sushi!
Each dumpling is packed with mystery meat and magic. Who knows what spell you'll cast with a belly full of these!
Circular, chewy, and slightly magical.
Wield it like a sword or devour it like a hero. This crusty loaf has seen more battles than you can chew.
Dark, rich, and full of forbidden coco magic!
Each grain of rice is infused with the essence of the ocean, and every shrimp tells tales of the deep sea. A dish that's truly out of this realm!
Stacked with a patty as mighty as a minotaur and sauces as mysterious as the dark woods, this burger is a feast fit for a champion.
Crafted from the finest greens in the realm!
A chest containing fragments of lost relics. Though aged, with some polishing and careful assembly they could form a relic that looks as good as new. What could possibly go wrong?

A chest containing a selection of dishes for picky pets, all prepared by master chefs. Premium quality at reasonable prices, with delivery to every corner of the Realm. If you're satisfied with our services, don't forget to recommend us to your friends.
Every self-respecting adventurer prepares before a journey, so the Tinkerer crafted a special chest. But when monsters ambushed the delivery, the chests were scattered across the Realm.
A chest filled with enchantment necessities of all kinds and forms. It is said to be modeled after the Great Enchanter's personal vault, though no one can confirm or deny such rumors.

A mysterious chest-like creature that enjoys playing pranks on its temporary owner by transforming into different chests. No one truly knows what it is or when it was first spotted, as it never remains the same.
Lost for ages, this chest contains relics coveted by every and all.
Use this chest to obtain a Legion weapon of choice.
Use this chest to obtain a Legion armor of choice.
Use this chest to obtain a Legion ability of choice.
"FOOLS! Flee while you can!" - Oryx The Mad God
"FOOLS! Flee while you can!" - Oryx The Mad God
"FOOLS! Flee while you can!" - Oryx The Mad God
"FOOLS! Flee while you can!" - Oryx The Mad God
The evergreen plant fibers woven into this robe pulse with an unusual vibrance. Consecrated in the magic of the forest, this garment lifts your steps and emboldens your mind.

EffectInfo.name: Fey Assistance
EffectInfo.description: 3% chance to spawn a fairy while shooting.

Object.Description: This ghastly blade has the power to emit waves of energy that dance like wraiths in the dark.
This lightwave blade is carefully attuned to madness harmonics in a revolutionary attempt to remotely blast any region with the fury of the F.E.R.A.L.'s energy attack.
An ancient tome covered with fleshy appendages. It contains the secrets to magic often considered blasphemous by priests, used to inflict horrible pain on others.

EffectInfo.description: Mark the location creating a Berserk aura in a radius of3.

EffectInfo.name: Second activation
EffectInfo.description: Teleport back to the marked location exploding the previous mark dealing 1000 damage and granting Armored for 5 seconds in a radius of 5.

EffectInfo.name: Note
EffectInfo.description: Mark is reset upon changing area or after 8 seconds.

Object.Description: A fragmented prism that is constantly mending its cracks and refracturing. Pulling pieces apart can create an unstable link between two spaces as the prism tries to become whole again.

Placing this trinket into an appropriate slot found on Steamworks machines activates their overclock drastically increasing output. The increased speed causes a greater amount of wear on the parts of the machine, usage of this item is only authorized to higher ranking Kogbolds.

Forged in silvered fire and etched with sacred sigils, this ring hums with the presence of a vigilant spirit. When called upon, the guardian Komainu emerges to shield its bearer, tempering harm and sharpening strength with the ferocity of a divine protector.

EffectInfo.name: Komainu
EffectInfo.description: On ability use with full meter, summon a Guardian Komainu for 8 seconds providing players within 3 tiles with Armored and Damaging.

Meter.chargeString: Charge the meter by killing Enemies. Killing Evil Yokais will grant 5x more meter.

Object.Description: Mystery Chest containing cosmetics of MotMG 2025.
This heavy blade is an unnatural channel for raw, condensed life-force.
Once a ceremonial blade used in rituals to siphon life, this dirk is perpetually vicious to the touch.

EffectInfo.name: Fires an additional shot every 2 seconds that deals 200-300 damage and exposes for 1 second.

Object.Description: A well crafted wand, favored by those who practice ceremonial and blood-based dark magic.

EffectInfo.name: Forbidden Secrets
EffectInfo.description: 40% Chance on ability to curse the user for 4 seconds. 5 second cooldown.

EffectInfo.name: Untold Power
EffectInfo.description: If the bearer is cursed while using the Ceremonial Wand, it fires two additional projectiles that deal 70-95 armor piercing damage.

Object.Description: Forged by the Hemomancer's underlings, this katana is a morbid masterpiece of steel and blood magic.
A cursed weapon of evil descent, shooting arrows of solidified blood.
This scepter is an instrument of blatant heresy, twisted and carved from anathematized elderwood.
A shield from a place beyond the gates of war and peace.
This wickedly curved branch was taken from the site of a mass ritual and permanently etched with the blood of its victims.

EffectInfo.description: 15% chance with a 0.4 second cooldown to release a Forgotten Soul
EffectInfo.name: On Shoot

EffectInfo.description: Drifts away after 5 seconds, inflicting Curse for 4 seconds upon detonation
EffectInfo.name: Soul Charge

Object.Description: This crude bundle of ceremonial instruments is held together by a thick crust of dried ichor.
This heavy weapon was once blessed, but has been defiled and repurposed by a cult of fanatics who practice blood sacrifice.

Object.id: Venerable Staff of the Crystal Serpent
Object.Description: An ancient staff used both for sacrifice and communion with the gods.
A dagger that was condemned to Davy Jones' Locker.
A sound almost like a wind chime emanates softly from this wand.
Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.
A worn and battered suit of armor embedded with a mystic gem that flows with magical strength.

EffectInfo.description: On taking more than 40 damage gain Energized for 3 seconds
EffectInfo.name: Mystic Gem

Object.id: Venerable Robe of the Mad Scientist
Object.Description: A well-worn robe used for Science!

EffectInfo.name: Scientist's Expertise
EffectInfo.description: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 15%

Object.Description: Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
The malachite stone makes you feel at peace with the land.

EffectInfo.name: Rite of the Sphinx
EffectInfo.description: Reduces the Magic casting cost of your Ability by 10%

Object.Description: The azure stone makes you feel ready for any situation.
The dolomite stone makes you feel able to stand against anything.
An etched starmatter gem atop a gilded band, commemorating the past 10 years of the Heroes of the Nexus' fight against the forces of Oryx.
A sleek blade tempered in the restless currents of RetroWinds, made for swift and silent strikes.
A finely strung bow that carries the song of RetroWinds with every arrow fired.
An ancient staff humming with the energy of RetroWinds, guiding its wielder's magic along winding paths.
A slender wand marked with flowing lines, drawing the strange power of RetroWinds into every spell.
A gleaming sword forged where the winds turn back on themselves, its edge shining with old power.
A graceful katana whose flowing edge echoes the swift winds of RetroWinds.
A flowing robe woven from iridescent threads that ripple like the unseen currents of RetroWinds.
Supple armor layered with wind-worn scales, granting its wearer the nimble grace of RetroWinds.
Heavy armor shaped by relentless gales, bearing the enduring strength of RetroWinds.
Engraving for Retrowinds Items.

EffectInfo.description: When used in the enchanter, applies the following effects:

EffectInfo.name: Additional Effect
EffectInfo.description: When used on Retrowinds items, guarantees the Retrowinds mod.

Object.Description: A ring made from the eye of the Snake Queen.
A ring crafted from the faceted eye of an enormous spider.
A dagger fashioned from the fang of an enormous spider.
No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.
Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.
An enchanted cloak crafted by an ancient guild of timeshifter thieves.
Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.
Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this Katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.
Fashioned from the finest logs found within the Woodland Labyrinths, this bow uses sharp leaves instead of conventional arrows. Such lightweight ammunition allows for quick movement.
This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.
Light armor crafted from the hard-as-steel leafy scales of a Leaf Dragon.
A magic robe woven from enchanted threads of water harvested from a great Water Dragon's body.
Battle armor made from Fire Dragon scales, one of the strongest substances this world has ever seen.
An ancient weapon imbued with the power of the cosmos.
An eerie reminder of what lays in the depths of the Shatters.
An odd stone, emanating a dark and mysterious energy.
Wearing it makes you feel particularly strong.
A swift and hungry blade that is never satisfied with just one kill.
A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.

A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

Object.id: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
Object.Description: A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.

EffectInfo.description: Lures enemies in and attacks them within 6 tiles.
EffectInfo.name: Jumpscare

Object.Description: Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons that last for 5 seconds and chases enemies
EffectInfo.name: Summons

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons with 1500 HP that last for 10 seconds and protects the user.
EffectInfo.name: Summons

EffectInfo.description: Undead skeletons heal 50 HP within 5 squares upon decaying.
EffectInfo.name: Ash and Dust

Object.Description: An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

EffectInfo.description: Inflicts a poison within 4 squares dealing 750 damage over 3.6 seconds.
Enemies under the effect of the poison receive 12% more damage from you, scaling with DEX.
Damage boost is increased by 7% for every 10 DEX above 50.

Object.Description: A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.
An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.

EffectInfo.description: While holding down the ability key, drain 50 MP/sec and become Weakened.
While holding down the ability key, release a stream of bubbles whilst shooting scaling with your Lethal Strike Damage.
+60 damage and 10% of the enemies defense as damage.
EffectInfo.name: Lethal Strike

EffectInfo.description: +1 flat damage and +1% of the enemies defense per wis over 34.
EffectInfo.name: Lethal strike scaling

Object.Description: An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.

EffectInfo.description: Turn into a powerful crustacean for 6 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Evolution

EffectInfo.description: Gain two additional projectiles on shoot which deal 80-110 damage.
EffectInfo.name: Transformation Perks

EffectInfo.description: Turn into a powerful reptile for 6 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Evolution

EffectInfo.description: Gain two additional projectiles on shoot which deal 90-110 damage.
EffectInfo.name: Transformation Perks

EffectInfo.description: Turn into a powerful insect for 6 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Evolution

EffectInfo.description: Gain two additional projectiles on shoot which deal 40-60 armour piercing damage.
EffectInfo.name: Transformation Perks

Object.Description: A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

EffectInfo.description: Consumes most of your available MP upon casting the poison. The greater the amount of MP consumed the more potent the explosion.
EffectInfo.name: Arcane Nourishment

EffectInfo.description: Pollen lingers within 10 squares of ground zero, dealing 120-200 damage.
EffectInfo.name: Pollen Fallout

Object.Description: A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

EffectInfo.description: Sick on self when in combat. Gain an ATK boost the lower your HP is.
EffectInfo.name: On Shoot

Object.Description: A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.

EffectInfo.description: Conjure mysterious runes that deal 110-160 damage every 0.6 seconds to enemies within 5 squares, lasting 6 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Rune Carvings

Object.Description: Survival of the fittest.
Survival of the fittest.
Survival of the fittest.

Object.id: Deep Sea Abyss Cloak Proc 1 Shiny
Object.Description: Inhale, exhale.

Object.id: Deep Sea Abyss Cloak Proc 2 Shiny
Object.Description: Inhale, exhale.

An extremely heavy axehead salvaged from Griefkeeper Zole's rather bulky choice of weaponry. Throwing it takes a tremendous amount of effort, but it has the capacity to obliterate everything in its path.

EffectInfo.description: Launches a giant projectile with 7 hitboxes
EffectInfo.name: Unstoppable Force

EffectInfo.description: On shooting after ability use, restore 2MP/shot for 5s.
EffectInfo.name: Relentless Recharge

Object.Description: This relic was once used by a secluded cult of dragon worshippers. A druid may tap into its arcane power to embrace the form of a dragon.

EffectInfo.description: When the meter is full switch the ability to take the form of a Dragon for 8.5s. Gaining 40 Wis, 15 Def, Dragon Breath, and tripling fireball scaling. Reduces weapon range by 33%
EffectInfo.name: Dragon Form

Meter.chargeString: Charge the meter by using your ability or hitting enemies.

EffectInfo.description: On ability use gain energized recovering 20 mp/s for 2s. While energized breathe fire on attack, each shot deals 15 damage plus 1 for every wis over 100.
EffectInfo.name: Dragon Breath

Object.Description: Believed to be some kind of artificial organ, this sheath embeds the weapon in a solid crystal coating before violently fracturing into shrapnel when drawn.
A beautiful set of ornate ceremonial robes, filled with the energy of benevolent spirits from long ago.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a Friendly Spirit which heals allies and zaps enemies for 150 damage/sec.
EffectInfo.name: On Ability Use

EffectInfo.description: The spirit synergizes in the presence of different spirits.
Healing buff and heals 10 HP/sec within 3 squares.
Healing buff and heals 20 HP/sec within 3 squares.

Object.Description: A festival coat woven from thin, spiritual threads. It allows the user to skirt the spirit realm in search of their destination.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a Friendly Spirit which curses enemies and zaps them for 150 damage/sec.
EffectInfo.name: On Ability Use

EffectInfo.description: The spirit synergizes in the presence of different spirits.
Curses and deals 100 damage/sec within 3 squares.
Curses and deals 200 damage/sec within 3 squares.

Object.Description: A worn plate from the Sage's armor. Its outwardly poor condition belies a strange, revitalizing effect still flowing within.

EffectInfo.description: Summon a Friendly Spirit which slows enemies and zaps them for 150 damage/sec.
EffectInfo.name: On Ability Use

EffectInfo.description: The spirit synergizes in the presence of different spirits.
Slows and deals 100 damage/sec within 3 squares.
Slows and deals 200 damage/sec within 3 squares.

Object.Description: A piece of the Artificial Slop in a state of constant change, never holding the same form for more than a moment.

EffectInfo.description: 4% chance to summon a slime that chases enemies
EffectInfo.name: On Enemy Hit

Object.Description: Imbued with haunting energies of a foreign rite, the layered blade of this shadowy tool is never finished with its victim.

EffectInfo.name: On shooting while Berserk
EffectInfo.description: Gain the Damaging buff for 1 second.

Object.Description: A memento of a life long gone. You can still feel the warmth from years past through the frigid ice that has taken over.
The source of power for the Marble Colossus found within his core. It is intended to give life to golems, but it can provide benefits to the living as well.
A strange bludgeoning weapon known for leaving extreme wounds on enemies with its perfect ninety degree angles.
Although quite simple, its sound is unmistakable. This isn't just any triangle.

EffectInfo.description: On use, quadruples shot speed for 4 seconds.
EffectInfo.name: Self Only

Best of friends, helping each other out, they're stuck together like glue. Being together for so long they're able to sync to the music they play and dance in the battle field as one, its a sight to behold these two coiled up friends. \n\nSkin Class: Bard

Coming from the harsh desert regions of the realms. Originally they were off on a quest in search of powerful weapons to aid their sandy kingdom. But over time the knight grew different desires that the realm offers, and is now hungry for power. \n\nSkin Class: Knight
A powerful necromancer and a natural magic user at that. Rumors circle around that the Serpent Lord made a deal with said beast in favor of unlocking more powerful magic. \n\nSkin Class: Necromancer

This sweet sentient strawberry is driven by one thing only and that's to give all inhabitants of the realm a sweet treat.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner
Time to hatch your way into victory.\n\nSkin Class: Archer
This carrot enjoys their time meditating in the ground, even in the middle of battle, they still find time to relax and keep their cool despite the chaos surrounding them.\n\nSkin Class: Samurai

'Work smart, not hard' is this Kensei's motto. He enjoys lazing around, disguising himself as an Easter egg until his target's curiosity lures them into his sword's range - unfortunately, that means break time is over.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei

With every swing, he nourishes the realm, bringing a burst of morale to his allies, while his radiance grows brighter, just like a freshly plucked carrot basking in the sunlight.\n\nSkin Class: Paladin
Let your enemies tremble before this sugary menace and maybe try not to nibble on your minions along the way!\n\nSkin Class: Summoner

This geomancer channels the realms spring season through their magical bell. With every bell ring they make the flowers flourish and sing. They leave a colorful trail of flowers with each swing of their bell.\n\nSkin Class: Assassin

In a field of sunflowers, one stood too tall, its petals too bright, its face turned just wrong. Beneath the golden guise hid a trickster spirit, grinning behind silken petals, swaying not with the wind but with intent—watching, waiting, blooming only for mischief.\n\nSkin Class: Trickster

Clad in robes of ivy and blooms, the wizard carried a staff crowned with a glowing lotus. With every step, flowers awakened, and ancient magic whispered through petals and vines.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard

This wise druid enjoys the simple pleasures of life, walks around the forest, tea time, napping, and protecting the forest. They wield the ability to talk to tree’s, able to have conversations with them but for the average hero they just see a rambling goat who likes to complain about the current generation of heroes.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic

Ever since this clown survived the lost halls, this jester was never the same. Instead of making jokes and giving hugs with heroes they’re making monsters laugh too, this jester wants to go beyond making the realm joyous, instead they want to make the entire cosmos come together with smiles, some heroes speculate that traces of the void remain in this jester.\n\nSkin Class: Trickster
Equipped with a trusty grapple gun and safety gear, this cave explorer swings ventures deepest dark caves and dungeons in search of forgotten secrets.\n\nSkin Class: Archer

This Kensei has grown attached to their blade, equipping it with powerful runes and trinkets they’ve gathered from their adventures, hoping to bringing the blades potential out in full display.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei
Through wind, rain, and the dangerous foes morning and night, this fox delivers hope, one letter at a time.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard

Cursed by the Crystal Entity for obsessively raiding their crystal caverns too many times, as a result this knights body has transformed them into a crystallized hero. They now wear their curse as a badge of honor, roaming the realms as a glorious expensive shining knight.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
Born of collapsing stars and seething nebulae, this arcane form channels the fury of the cosmos.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
A guardian cast in celestial flame, sworn to shield the light between the stars.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
A swift shadow streaking through starlight, leaving only silence and awe in their wake.\n\nSkin Class: Rogue
Deep in the ocean trenches, the sea druid has decided to take matters into their own hands and hopes to free their sea creature friends from Oryx’s clutches.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard

Ah, the Exalted God. I must admit, I am surprised to see your kind even dignify him with that title. Oryx would tell you that his exalted form is the result of his holy status, affirming himself as the realm’s greatest god. In truth, this exaltation comes from a twisted version of a far greater power. Intended to strengthen righteous heroes, he has managed to corrupt it for his own uses.\n\nSkin Class: Knight

Object.id: Exalted Mad God Oryx Paladin Skin
Object.Description: Ah, the Exalted God. I must admit, I am surprised to see your kind even dignify him with that title. Oryx would tell you that his exalted form is the result of his holy status, affirming himself as the realm’s greatest god. In truth, this exaltation comes from a twisted version of a far greater power. Intended to strengthen righteous heroes, he has managed to corrupt it for his own uses.\n\nSkin Class: Paladin

After a long time of hibernating and mastering the art of bite and claw, this big bear now goes out facing powerful foes to prove their Martial Arts is the strongest there is in the realms.\n\nSkin Class: Samurai
Coming from the winter lands, this fox gracefully traverses the realm showing off their winter moves drawing in a crowd of protective followers.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner
Having lost everything from Oryx’s reign but their musical guitar, they chant and sing songs for their fallen heroes.\n\nSkin Class: Bard
This thirsty priest has their own unique ways of healing, with magical potions, one swig of their healing concoction will cure you right up and leave you walking funny.\n\nSkin Class: Priest
Both introverted and invested in blood magic, their questionable healing methods are powerful yet dangerous for heroes not strong enough to endure it.\n\nSkin Class: Priest

Gifted with a magical branch that instantly grows into a bow, this fairy is now able to express their tree hugging tendencies by protecting them from Oryx and many of the threats that roam the lands.\n\nSkin Class: Huntress
This unrest soul roams the realms hungry for power and violence. They wear a demon mask and shadowy cloak becoming a true terror of the night.\n\nSkin Class: Ninja
A spectral wanderer draped in ethereal veils, the Ghost Mystic channels whispers from beyond. Neither fully here nor gone, their presence bends the veil between worlds.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
Once an honorable blade master, now bound by infernal power. The Demon Kensei strikes with unholy precision, every swing echoing with the fury of the underworld.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei

A fish who swam into enchanted water causing them to transform into a magical creature able to walk on land, they bless the paths they lead, splashing around holy water everywhere they go.\n\nSkin Class: Priest
Created from dozens of fallen cubes and a glass of enchanted blood, combining the two has brought these gelatinous squares back to life in the form of a spherical being.\n\nSkin Class: Necromancer

This barbaric blood thirsty viking wants nothing more than to satisfy their hunger for battle, they've become so battle crazed they lose sight on who's friend or foe and instead letting their axe do the talking.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
Who says you can't tame a spider for battle? This clever Mystic was determined to prove everyone wrong - and show them how it's done.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
Once alive, now bound in stone, the Bard still watches over those in need.\n\nSkin Class: Bard
Once a mighty clan, the Blackbird Kensei now stand few. They no longer wait for justice, but create it on their own.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei
Their appearance may seem ghostly and cold, but they enjoy calling out to their winter friends to dance and play in the snow.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner
The enemies of the realm had better watch out for this Pilgrim because they're out and ready to hunt!\n\nSkin Class: Huntress

Deep within the dungeons lied a special hammer made of crystal and snow, it's now in this Hero's hand which slowly influences them the essence of frost bringing the winter wherever they go.\n\nSkin Class: Paladin
Be very quiet. I'm hunting shinies.\n\nSkin Class: Huntress
Draped in sacred threads, this tiny figure channels forgotten rites, letting ancient voices sing once more through enchanted melodies.\n\nSkin Class: Bard
A magical frost entity able to conjure up snow from the their magically cold hands.\n\nSkin Class: Archer
A highly mobile glaive-wielding scout, assigned to frostbit arctic regions for swift assassinations.\n\nSkin Class: Assassin
A creedless Oni from a long-vanquished clan. His sole memento is a katana, whose engraved hilt he prefers untouched.\n\nSkin Class: Samurai
No matter how dangerously cold the weather gets, nothing is getting past this necromancer's nice warm parka.\n\nSkin Class: Necromancer
Customize your Rogue with the Mini Spectral Sentry Rogue Mini Skin.\n\nSkin Class: Rogue
Ruler of skulls and frost, this necromancer rides in style, using their dangerous frost fingertips to conjure terror upon their foes.\n\nSkin Class: Necromancer
Made from soft, falling snow, clumped together and given life by the magical properties of the realm that flow into the lands.\n\nSkin Class: Archer
This frost entity can easily keep enemies at bay with its large, towering ice shield and hammer, serving as a solid wall of defense that protects anyone standing behind it. \n\nSkin Class: Knight
The essence of love has formed and has now gone out to help spread the love to all the heroes and foes. \n\nSkin Class: Summoner
A crazy witch in love, focused on spreading the love towards heroes and foes, their divine mission is making the entire realm fall in the name of love. \n\nSkin Class: Necromancer

A servant for Belladonna and her roses, they have an important rescue mission in search of flowers that are in need of help. The rose keeper hopes to rebuild Belladonna’s army of flowers and bring the realm back to a floral state. \n\nSkin Class: Necromancer
Wrap yourself in this cozy garment, perfect for braving the frosty season in style.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Oryxmas Druid Skin!\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Hold on, I was told this unlocks a random Druid skin!
A mechanical raptor engineered to keep machinery in perfect condition.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
She refused to leave after the corruption took its toll on the village. It was her home after all.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
She was neither a sprite nor a cube. She was something entirely new.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Her connection to nature is strong, even for a druid.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
He is moving a bit slow today, but he plans on having a good day anyway.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
He is a natural druid. Metamorphosis is in his blood.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
In the darkness, their eternal strife ignites anew.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Off to work we go!\n\nSkin Class: Druid
"None of the forms I took could resist the great evil that had befallen us."\n\nSkin Class: Druid
First I was afraid, I was petrified... And then I realized I could still move. Huh, Craig's really bad at rituals.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
A Druid that has reached their full potential.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
The Syndicate, too, has its unsung rank-and-file enforcers.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
A champion of insight.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Full steam ahead!\n\nSkin Class: Druid
She undergoes a comprehensive twelve step horn care routine to maintain horns that look this good.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Discord officer: Requesting backup, rules broken outside of the realm!
The cold realms are no problem for this elf. They can fend off any winter threat; the only real danger they face is satisfying their big appetite. \n\nSkin Class: Druid

Originating from the crystal caverns, they found themselves tumbling into magma and rock. Now they search the hot lands for delicious minerals to eat, leaving their mark on the realms with every roll. \n\nSkin Class: Druid
This penguin learned to get around the realm by sliding on its belly. Its fur, coated with magical properties, allows it to glide across the surface with ease. \n\nSkin Class: Druid
Rewarded to those that have served in the battle against Oryx for years. We thank you for your service.\n\nSkin Class: Druid
His eyesight is impeccable. It needs to be when facing his greatest enemy, Biff.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
She may look silly, but her paws pack quite the punch.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner
Reawakened once more, this golem searches for a kingdom of flames that is no more. Able to heat up its hands and create dangerous sparks, it leaves behind embers of its past.\n\nSkin Class: Samurai
A drifting jellyfish spirit that wanders gracefully, unfamiliar with the world above the waves.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
This octopus was suspended from the ocean for its disrespectful behavior. Now it must spend its timeout terrorizing the realms with its attitude.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner

Full of ambition and dreams of one day becoming a famous singer, this mermaid ventures into the realms to sing songs from the deep. Her screeching voice is so powerful that not even the strongest foes can withstand it. \n\nSkin Class: Druid
Don't tread on this hermit crab. It might be shy, but it packs a powerful claw when provoked—this is one crab you don't want to mess with.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner
An armor that bears the battle-worn colors of Oryx's Legion!\n\nSkin Class: Druid
Once a prestigious druid, her descent into the madness of Nightmatter has transformed her into something that couldn't be further from nature. \n\nSkin Class: Druid
Even in death, she cannot escape the night. \n\nSkin Class: Necromancer

Originally coming from the toxic sewers, instead of scavenging for cheese they now search for only the most pristine of cheeses and treasure along the way. A real pest for Gemsbok to deal with.\n\nSkin Class: Ninja
This tiny priest squeaks their way towards the battlefield healing heroes, critters and most importantly, mousy friends.\n\nSkin Class: Priest
Wild blorgorms may seem aggressive but they are simply trying to play. If one were to play along they could soon tame them and become a blorg rider!\n\nSkin Class: Knight

Commander Calbrik left his secret weapon the Neo Combat Suit behind. Now everyone can pretend to be a galactic conqueror! It does make you think, what does Calbrik look like under the suit?\n\nSkin Class: Huntress

Coming from outer space leaving behind a slippery trail, this alien is curious about the inhabitants of the realms and what it has to offer. They slide wherever they go at incredible speed despite being a slug.\n\nSkin Class: Sorcerer
No matter the threat that comes from space, these space warriors are here to help keep the enemies at bay from causing more issues the realms face.\n\nSkin Class: Warrior

Originally part of the mushroom tribe, they've gotten caught in the crossfire with aliens and were abducted. They were experimented, studied and made into the perfect alien shroom soldier but their indomitable mushroom spirit remained and with a new enlightened perspective. Too strange and seen as an enemy for the fungal cavern, they venture out in hopes of sharing their new found knowledge with other realm inhabitants.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

The Cosmic Snare uses its tentacle appendages for just about everything for movement, feeling, eating and attacking. Because of this they can be quiet touchy, sometimes getting too close to comfort, while at the same time being easily provoked if annoyed. Despite this alien's short temper they're benevolent enough to help the heroes of this realm, curious and amused by their motives.\n\nSkin Class: Necromancer

This martian was given another chance at life thanks to one of the many heroes of realm, this time from a monk showing the invader mercy. They told the invader if they wish to conquer, one must conquer themselves. With a new goal and way of fighting, the martian hopes of one day defeating this monk. The monk saw potential in the alien invader and hopes one day they'll blossom into a powerful warrior so they can enjoy what they've learned and give the monk a fun challenge.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner

No matter how long it takes to get to your destination, this space taxi will make it happen. Nothing will keep this taxi from getting their customer to their destination. All absurd prices are non-negotiable, and any customer problems will be dealt with. Thank you for choosing Space Taxi.\n\nSkin Class: Summoner

Despite claiming to help the heroes of the realm and stop Oryx, this trooper has plans beyond the realms, using the powerful resources and goods the realm has to offer, they seek power to help aid their insane power hungry goal of dominating not only the realm but the galaxy itself.\n\nSkin Class: Archer

A rare species of alien slugs that are able to use their toxic slime to thwart off any threat, their most unique trait is the ability to mimic the shape of many species. They use their shape shifting skills when confronted by a overwhelmingly dominating species as a defence mechanism by blending in with the crowd in hopes of continuing their survival unscathed.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
With all the fights and brawls that occur, someone has to clean up the mess. Luckily, this alligator is always on duty.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
Their softly made attire allows them to sneak around without leaving a trace despite the bright flamingo-like colors.\n\nSkin Class: Rogue

Originally living a life of sun and sleep, they’re now given a chance to seek a new desire beyond the sun. All thanks to a witch who saw a growing potential from this leaf having a stronger desire beyond sunlight.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

Coming from a plane of reality inhabited by squares, this amalgamation of tiny cubes has found itself flung from its square-like reality into the realm’s atmosphere like a shooting star.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
An astral knight whose origin seems to be far across the star.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
Through their enchanted music, this bard brings harmony from the far reaches of the cosmos.\n\nSkin Class: Bard

This Druid’s lifespan stretches across time, their roots intertwined with the Realm. They possess knowledge of history unknown to many, thanks to the enchanted trees that have endured within the Realm for centuries.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

Days turned into years as this wizard dedicated their entire life to studying the art of time. Luckily, they lived long enough to ascend and gain a grasp of its inner workings. Now gifted with enough time, they can continue their research and further understand the fabric of time itself.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard
Customize your Mystic with the Mini Timekeeper Mystic Skin.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic

Once a farmer in their past life, they now rise again, lingering within the fallen leaves. During a full moon, a hunger grows inside of them; instead of harvesting crops, they harvest souls.\n\nSkin Class: Huntress
A lantern-bearing jester who lurks and snickers in the shadows, waiting to turn a little mischief into mayhem.\n\nSkin Class: Trickster
A masked marksman who turns the battlefield into a deadly dance—a sight to behold. Any unfortunate foes caught in the crossfire had better watch out.\n\nSkin Class: Archer

Queen Tiramisu is very fond of Bing Cat, Miss Cancan, and her beloved Realmers. She hears the kingdom’s complaints and will gladly go punch the royal council on your behalf. She is a little temperamental, so behave, or she'll punch you too.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
A tiny keeper of ancient bones, breathing new life into creatures long forgotten.\n\nSkin Class: Druid

Before meeting their demise at the hands of a paladin, a vengeful reptile goddess cursed the paladin, causing them to transform into a reptilian monster. Despite their transformation and hiding their appearance out of shame, their heart hasn’t faltered. They continue to fight to this day in hopes of finding a cure.\n\nSkin Class: Paladin

This snake used to be mean and ruthless. Then one day, after sleeping in the Floral Escape, flowers began to grow on their head. As a result, the snake’s temper has calmed down significantly.\n\nSkin Class: Kensei

A calm king who spends long hours reading every concern and emotional outburst his subjects bring him. He takes it all to heart and will fight the royal council for them without a second thought. He has a soft spot for Bing Cat, but misbehave and he'll still punch you.\n\nSkin Class: Knight
This invertebrate is unusually distinct from a sea slurp. An aquamagic invention gave birth to its coral staff, which emulates the sound of the ocean.\n\nSkin Class: Wizard

Within the beastfolk lies a species of humanoid snakes, known for their amazing dance moves and ability to allure heroes and foes. Their dances are so dangerous that if one was continuing to gaze at their rhythmic moves, they’ll be put under a hypnotic spell.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic
So...tell me, Hero. The words... I've been waiting to hear.\n\nSkin Class: Mystic

Object.Description: Many fishmen refashion select breeds of Deep Sea Beasts into portable accessories for their weapons. They are fed a strict diet of poisonous urchins, which helps keeps any stashed items particularly deadly.

EffectInfo.description: Arrows deal 100-130 armor piercing damage. These arrows gain 1 Damage per wisdom over 34.

Object.Description: An odd contraption created by Thessal in hopes of creating Coral Juice more efficiently. Extracting coral juice by hand was too tedious of a task, so by taking advantage of the ocean's pressure, this machine is able to extract the juice automatically.
A bow fashioned from living coral found in only the deepest ocean trenches. It is the favored weapon of those that inhabit the realms beneath the waves.
A trap imbued with deadly venom from the coral of the Ocean Trench.
Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.
A ring crafted from the dangerous Fire Coral.

Made for the season's celebrations, this sword has passed between many heroes. Each owner added another story to its long history.
Every year, this dagger was awarded to the winner of a contest held during the kingdom's sweetest celebration.
Long ago, a skilled baker offered this bow to the hero who saved his village. It has changed hands many times since.
Few know who first owned this staff, but every story about it ends with a great feast and an unexpected victory.

Meter.chargeString: Charge the meter by shooting!

Object.Description: Once given as a simple reward, the wand later became a treasured relic. It has been carried by adventurers on long journeys.
A closely guarded recipe was used to make this katana, though its final ingredient remains a secret to this day.
A sweet reward for those who always come back for another helping.
The restored and enhanced remains of a raptor limb. It imbues its wielder with predatory instinct.
A decayed charm relighting only a fraction of a primal beast’s flame.

InteractInfo.title: Fishing with Glover
InteractInfo.text:
Greetings adventurers, welcome to my Fish Pond!
To catch fish is pretty easy, just grab a rod from that wooden barrel to my left and consume it like a potion! This will cause you to set out your line at your feet. Use your Summon control to bring it to a ripple in the water to catch fish! Bring me fish of the appropriate tier and you'll be rewarded kindly!
 Have fun! 
 
 P.S: Watch out for the big one!

Adventurers, the situation is dire! I need your help to exterminate these pesky rats that have overrun the city.\n\n Kill as many as you can see around this area, and come back here to spend any Rat Coins you find to buy assistance from cats.
InteractInfo.title: Rodent Hunting with Herman

Object.HelperDialog: The Enchanter can reroll enchantments on your items using dust. Discover powerful combinations with high rarity equipment and Artifacts from the Realm.
Dungeons offer challenging encounters with generally stronger enemies and bosses. They reward higher-quality loot, with harder dungeons granting better rewards and valuable Stat Potions.

Enter the Realm of the Mad God and begin your adventure. Defeat monsters, conquer Dungeons, teleport to other players, and claim valuable loot. Death is permanent, but you can return to safety at any time using your Escape to Nexus key ({0} by default). Clear enough enemies to close the portal and you may earn a one-way ticket to the almighty Oryx castle.
This is your home! Here you can store your personal items and will be safekept in your chest. Progress in your journey to unlock great means to empower your equipment.
Stay up to date with ongoing events and the latest news. Check here to see what is happening in the Realm.
Here you can meet your fellow guildmates, if you have enlisted in a guild of course. Try chatting with the friendly Guill, or even asking him for 'potions'!

Object.Description: This will make your Guild Hall larger and more attractive. This takes effect immediately after purchase.
This will make your Guild Hall larger and more attractive. This takes effect immediately after purchase.
This will make your Guild Hall larger and more attractive. This takes effect immediately after purchase.

Object.HelperDialog: Colorful wares, useful and pretty! You can also use the Shop menu to see a full catalogue and latest discounts.
Hatch Eggs into Pets here at the Pet Yard and raise them into powerful companions. Eggs drop from enemies across the Realm and Dungeons. Speak with the Yard Caretaker to learn more.
Browse a selection of items, from useful upgrades to cosmetics. Check the Shop to see what's currently available.
Visit the Login Seer each day to claim your daily rewards. The more you return, the more you earn.
Bring quest items to the Tinkerer to receive special potions and chests. Marks dropped from Dungeon bosses are especially valuable to him.

Earn rewards just by playing. Don't forget to visit the Login Seer each day! You can also bring quest items to the Tinkerer to get special potions and chests. He loves Marks dropped from Dungeon bosses more than anything!
Names etched here will stand the test of time. The Wall of Fame honors those who have supported the Realm and secured their place in its history.
The Blacksmith forges new items by dismantling others. Unlock new recipes using Blueprints found across the Realm.

InteractInfo.text:
I am leaving this damned trench. I cannot take it with you anymore and your rules.
You've been at a constant spiral into someone I do not think I can recognize. Is this what you think he would've wanted?
Do not try to find me, do not send anyone to find me, do not even try to contact me. I won't respond.
Besides, even if you tried to find me, I don't think you of all people would want to go back where I am anyways.
Please, try to move on.

-P.
InteractInfo.title: Goodbye

The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Special delivery, straight from the sky!\n\nUnlocks the Mail Delivery Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Descending from the far reaches of the sky, this radiant star crash-landed into the Realm, beaming with cheer and eager for a taste of adventure.\n\nUnlocks the Twinkle Star Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

"After a long night of mining in the cave, the mountain didn't like the way I swung my pickaxe, so it crushed me and lit me on fire. But you know I didn't die. I crystallized. And now I'm an Emerald, darling — gleaming like a diamond and ready for the Realm."\n\nUnlocks the Crystallized Penguin Pet Skin of the Penguin family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A cheerful pup made of shimmering crystal, they gleam with joy and jingling with every step they make.\n\nUnlocks the Crystallized Dog Pet Skin of the Canine family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

This bouncy creature loves hopping around, watch as they explore the depths of the realm from piping hot dungeons to the coldest regions the realm has to offer, nothing stops this water balloon from adventure.\n\nUnlocks the Water Balloon Pet Skin of the Aquatic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

They float around silently judging everything and everyone that this eye comes into contact with.\n\nUnlocks the Judgemental Eye Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Once a chilled waddler of the icy seas, Ignis Penguin now blazes with fiery might. With every flap, sparks fly—proving even the coldest creatures can burn the brightest.\n\nUnlocks the Ignis Penguin Pet Skin of the Penguin family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

One of the more friendly lanterns who loves to play, better bring a towel when bringing this lantern along on your adventures.\n\nUnlocks the Cheerful Lantern Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Powerful magic has bound the blood of many fallen heroes combining it into a powerful entity.\n\nUnlocks the Blood Entity Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A divine spirit said to devour nightmares and guard the dreams of its master… though none recall who that master once was.\n\nUnlocks the Dream Eater Baku Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

No matter the season, nothing will stop this jolly snowman from hopping around giving all the inhabitants of the realm a jolly good time.\n\nUnlocks the Jolly Snowman Pet Skin of the Woodland family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A jingly bag of coins that waddles around, always looking for more treasure to add to itself.\n\nUnlocks the Bag Of Coins Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

This woodland critter is almost blindingly white. It has an affinity for traversing through frigid snow.\n\nUnlocks Snowpale Squirrel Pet Skin of the Woodland family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A blue clothed Magical Gnome that is hard to spot, living in secret within the trees.\n\nUnlocks the Blue Nisse Pet Skin of the Farm family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A green clothed Magical Gnome that is hard to spot, living in secret within the trees.\n\nUnlocks the Green Nisse Pet Skin of the Farm family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A red clothed Magical Gnome that is hard to spot, living in secret within the trees.\n\nUnlocks the Red Nisse Pet Skin of the Farm family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

An entity created from the drops of snow and crystal particles giving themselves a cosmic form as if originating from the stars above.\n\nUnlocks the Crystal Snow Deer Pet Skin of the Woodland family. This goat is most cheery during the holidays, they get so happy they can't help but show their joy using their horns to ram into things.\n\nUnlocks the Jingle Bell Goat Pet Skin of the Farm family. Blessed by ancient rites, this Horse embodies endurance, freedom, and the promise of fresh beginnings.\n\nUnlocks Zodiac Horse Pet Skin of the Farm family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Loving and kind, this pixie likes to sing and dance, a comforting companion for your adventures.\n\nUnlocks Lilac Pocket Pixie Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Fun and mischievous, this pixie likes to play and explore, a daring companion for your adventures.\n\nUnlocks Bluebell Pocket Pixie Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Bright and peppy, this curious phoenix waddles around witnessing the wonders of the realm.\n\nUnlocks the Baby Phoenix Pet Skin of the Avian family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Tempered and evolved, this phoenix soars across the sky leaving behind warm embers.\n\nUnlocks the Adult Phoenix Pet Skin of the Avian family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Cleaning their gold and taking baths are both things this leprechaun likes to do in the spring.\n\nUnlocks Spring Cleaning Leprechaun Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

This owl is able to warm its feathers to a crisp without harming itself—hot enough to keep warm and cook its next meal to perfection.\n\nUnlocks the Ember Owl Pet Skin of the Woodland family. A cube-shaped bunny living in a cube-shaped burrow in the Third Dimension.\n\nUnlocks the Blocky Bunny Pet Skin of the Exotic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Even slurps find bunnies cute. What does it mean if slurps keep slurp pets?\n\nUnlocks the Bunny Slurp Pet Skin of the Farm family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Most cubes are the most blood thirsty creatures ever to enter the Realm, but not this one.\n\nUnlocks Pet Cube Skin of the ???? family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

The sea calls upon an aquatic entity whose job is to keep land dwellers from causing trouble in the ocean—with its fists. Aggressively.\n\nUnlocks Hydro Djinn Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Unlike the usual legion elite katanas, the blade on this one is far denser and packed with even more Nightmatter.\n\nUnlocks the Nightmatter Katana Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

One of the legion elite’s strongest weapons, overloaded with Nightmatter.\n\nUnlocks the Nightmatter Sword Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Znorgs simply cannot stand phorgs and the two species have waged countless wars against each other. Surprisingly znorgs seem to get along pretty well with blorgs and may often be seen hanging around with them.\n\nUnlocks the Znorgling Pet Skin of the ? ? ? ? family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Plexes are very simple and stupid creatures, they may remain in place for a long time for no apparent reason. It is a wonder that such a specie survived extinction on the remains of Untaris but it's thanks to their ability to hide that they have survived both predators and the harsh and cold environment.\n\nUnlocks the Plexling Pet Skin of the ? ? ? ? family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Watchlings are curious creatures but they also get scared easily. Unfortunately despite being all eye they are short-sighted and must approach closely to assess a threat.\n\nUnlocks the Watchling Pet Skin of the ? ? ? ? family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Despite their small size the blades of a nano steel reaper are still sharp. Their small size allow them to do maintenance in the tightest sections of Katalund's factories.\n\nUnlocks the Nano Steel Reaper Pet Skin of the ? ? ? ? family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

This picky yet hungry invader traveled far to get a taste of this exotic realm and see what it has to offer.\n\nUnlocks the Neo Worm Pet Skin of the Insect family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Hungry for a challenge this space warrior travels across the cosmos venturing to different planets and finally the realms to fight its toughest foes.\n\nUnlocks the Blaster Droid Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Entity unknown, it prefers to take the shape of a stingray floating around gracefully. This entity is even more dangerous than a stingray, able to take shape and form into various things, deadly weapons included.\n\nUnlocks the Cosmic Ray Pet Skin of the Aquatic family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

These little robots' origins are unknown; they just appeared one day, roaming around aimlessly. Some claim these cute little bots were tasked with keeping the flow of time in order by zapping everything that moves.\n\nUnlocks the Clockwork Droid Pet Skin of the Automaton family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Even far from his throne, this diminutive king has lost none of his royal pride. He follows his chosen adventurer with his crown held high, expecting every command to be obeyed.\n\nUnlocks the Old King Pet Skin of the Humanoid family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

Despite being only a miniature likeness of Archdemon Malphas, this floating head has inherited all of his fiery temper. It follows close behind, glaring at anything foolish enough to cross its path.\n\nUnlocks the Malphas Head Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

A mischievous spirit haunting an ancient grave bell, ringing out an eerie chime wherever it goes.\n\nUnlocks the Grave Bell Poltergeist Pet Skin of the Spooky family. The skin will be added to your Pet Wardrobe in the Pet Yard and can be used to change the appearance of your pet!

The rogue relies on his speed to deal damage at medium range while avoiding attacks.
The archer has a long-range attack and can acquire very powerful weapons.
The wizard deals damage from a long distance and blasts enemies with powerful spells.
The priest attacks at long range and can heal himself and his allies.
The warrior wears strong armor and uses his magic helmet to inspire his allies in battle.
The knight fights at close range, wears very heavy armor, and uses his shield to stun enemies.
The paladin can deal damage at close range, wear armor and heal himself and his allies.
The assassin fights from medium range and uses poison to damage his enemies over time.
The necromancer drains life from his enemies to heal himself and his allies.
The huntress uses arrows and traps to defeat her enemies.
The mystic fights with a staff and uses her crystal orb to bind enemies to a distant plane.
The trickster fights with a dagger while using her magical prism to distract enemies.
The sorcerer uses his scepter to fire blasts of chain lightning at his enemies.
The ninja relies on speed and skill, using katanas and ninja stars to deal big damage.
The samurai fights with a katana and uses his wakizashi sidearm to expose enemy weak points.
The bard uses his lute to inspire allies and enhance their combat capabilities.
The summoner spawns monsters to fight for her and boost her damage output.
The kensei dashes and slashes enemies at close range to bolster his combat effectiveness.
The druid shapeshifts between forms to adapt to any battle.

Power demands sacrifice. Offer your life essence in the Blood Ritual to gain strength and greater rewards. The more you give, the more you receive. Such rituals are not always performed, so make the most of them while you can.
Personalize your character at the Wardrobe. Change your skin, title, gravestone, emotes and entrance.

Ready to move on? Convert your Seasonal character to Non-Seasonal and keep everything you've earned. New Seasons bring fresh challenges and better rewards, so you can always jump back in when you're ready.
The Crucible is not for the faint of heart. Enter to face greater danger with powerful trade-offs and better rewards. Strength may come at a cost, but are you willing to bear it?
