InteractInfo.title: Engineer's Records #1
InteractInfo.text: Today I have been appointed by their holiness as the overseer of the Mechanization project. Finally, we will be shedding the frail bodies that have cursed my kin for centuries and replacing them with eternal machines. Never again will we lose one of our greatest minds to the perils of age. Admittedly I have concerns about the success rate of the process, but as it was designed personally by our lord, I know I can brush those worries aside. I am incredibly honored and excited to be a part of bringing our race to the new era.\n\n-Toven, Head Kobold Engineer

InteractInfo.title: Engineer's Records #2
InteractInfo.text: Today was the first day of the mechanization process. The first 100 Kobolds have gone through and become Kogbolds. Yes, Kogbolds! I thought up the name myself, a fitting title for our new race. As suspected, the process designed by their holiness is working flawlessly. Each and every Kobold that heads in comes out with a whole new level of energy, like everything weighing them down was simply removed through mechanization. This is a fantastic success, but… the screaming that occurs during the process, it's unbearable. I can only imagine it as an overwhelming pain, but it's all worth it in the end, right?\n\n-Toven, Head Kobold Engineer

InteractInfo.title: Engineer's Records #3
InteractInfo.text:
Our lord must have noticed that overseeing the Mechanization project has caused a large amount of strain on my mental state, as I have been replaced by another engineer. Another Kobold, or I should say Kogbold. He has already been through the process after all, so that may be why he seems unfazed by his position. I remember him though. I remember all of the ones I saw undertake the transformation, his screaming was some of the worst, begging constantly for us to stop the procedure. However, after it was all over he seemed fine, as if nothing had ever happened. The same man he had always been. I can’t stay here, I can’t go through that process... 
I must find somewhere to hide.

-Toven, Head Kobold Engineer

InteractInfo.title: Engineer's Records #4
InteractInfo.text:
The final number was called over the loudspeaker today, my number. I was scheduled last because I was supposed to be overseeing all of the other ones. They will surely find me soon, but try as they might I won't go.

I won't go.

I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. I won't go. 

{color=#570E06}I WILL NOT GO.{/color}

-Toven, the last Kobold

InteractInfo.title: Research Note
InteractInfo.text:
{i}Findings have been frustratingly fruitful, as our every discovery marks greater complications. Interference mandates distance, instability mandates tempering, and the power of four is forbidden by certain prying eyes. One must be concealed, working silently from behind, but the illusion of three sources remains a...

...the detriment of the device. The immense potential of such a magnitude of magi must be tapped into, but these measures prove insufficient. Is it possible to elude a fate so certain? No amount...

...profound depths, hidden now from sight. He speaks of strength, but is still yet to embrace the latent energy strung across the palace. We are thinking only from our own lamentably narrow perspective. New ideas, grander thoughts, an enlightenment beyond what the court prophets pretend to comprehend, that is where wisdom patiently...

...end. To defy the surrender of one's conscious being, we must look to the one noble beast which cheats this law immemorial. By nature it holds the answer, and {color=#B53737}by nature we shall take our place.{/color}{/i}

EffectInfo.description: When consumed, wait for the notification popup!

A mysterious token imbued with the essence of balance—light and dark, order and chaos. It hums with an eerie energy, shifting between opposing forces as if caught between two destinies. Collecting enough of these may persuade the Tinkerer to share some of his hidden knowledge... or gear.

Object.id: Gaze of the Void Shard x1
Object.Description: Long ago, the Void was destroyed, and the heroes who achieved this became known as the Void Destroyers. Its shattered remnants were scattered across the Realm to prevent it from ever reassembling and rising again. Yet now, rumors whisper that someone seeks to restore the Void - and harness its power for themselves.

A seldom-known material that has recently been uncovered in alarming quantities in the Realm. Due to its precious quantity and versatile nature, it is extremely valuable, and can be used to create powerful equipment for battle. Despite its infamy among the smiths of the Nexus and the crafters of the Legion, the material itself is mysterious in its origin and usage. Upon further research, it seems that this material even possesses properties that bend space and time itself, creating windows into the past that act as visions of an elder Realm.

Object.Description: Tales speak of an item from ages past, banished from the world, yet whispered to last. Said to be wielded by Blood Mages of old, to strengthen their magic, its power untold. Now rumors abound, its location revealed, and heroes set forth, their fates soon sealed.
